records.english: It's one o'clock!’

records.chinese: 去年夏天，我去了意大利。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: I visited museums and sat in public gardens.
records.chinese: 我参观了博物馆，还坐在公共花园里。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
records.chinese: 一位友善的服务员教了我几句意大利语
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: Then he lent me a book.
records.chinese: 然后他借给我一本书。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: I read a few lines, but I did not understand a word.
records.chinese: 我读了几行，但一个字也看不懂。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: Every day I thought about postcards.
records.chinese: 我每天都想着明信片。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: My holidays passed quickly, but I did not send cards to my friends.
records.chinese: 我的假期过得很快，但我没有给朋友们寄明信片。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: On the last day I made a big decision.
records.chinese: 最后一天我做了一个重大决定。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: I got up early and bought thirty-seven cards.
records.chinese: 我起得很早，买了三十七张明信片。
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: I spent the whole day in my room,
records.chinese: 我在自己的房间里待了一整天，
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: but I did not write a single card!
records.chinese: 可我一张卡片都没写！
records.lesson: Lesson 3 Please send me a card

records.english: I have just received a letter from my brother, Tim.
records.chinese: 我刚收到我哥哥蒂姆的一封信。

records.english: He is in Australia.
records.chinese: 他在澳大利亚。

records.english: He has been there for six months.
records.chinese: 他在那里呆了六个月

records.english: Tim is an engineer.
records.chinese: 蒂姆是一名工程师。

records.english: He is working for a big firm and he has already visited a great number of different places in Australia.
records.chinese: 他在一家大公司工作，并且已经去过澳大利亚很多不同的地方。

records.english: He has just bought an Australian car and has gone to Alice Springs,
records.chinese: 他刚买了一辆澳大利亚产的汽车，并且已经前往艾丽斯斯普林斯了。

records.english: a small town in the centre of Australia.
records.chinese: 澳大利亚中部的一座小镇。

records.english: He will soon visit Darwin.
records.chinese: 他不久将访问达尔文。

records.english: From there, he will fly to Perth.
records.chinese: 从那里，他会飞到珀斯。

records.english: My brother has never been abroad before, so he is finding this trip very exciting.
records.chinese: 我哥哥以前从没出过国，所以他觉得这次旅行非常让人兴奋。

records.english: Mr.
records.chinese: 先生（加在男子姓氏或姓名前的尊称）

records.english: James Scott has a garage in Silbury and now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.
records.chinese: 詹姆斯·斯科特在锡尔伯里有一个车库，现在他刚在平赫斯特又买了一个车库。

records.english: Pinhurst is only five miles from Silbury, but Mr.
records.chinese: 平赫斯特离席伯里只有五英里，但是先生……

records.english: Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage, so he has just bought twelve pigeons.
records.chinese: 斯科特没法给他的新车库装一部电话，所以他刚买了十二只鸽子。

records.english: Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.
records.chinese: 昨天，一只鸽子把第一则消息从平赫斯特送到了西尔伯里。

records.english: The bird covered the distance in three minutes.
records.chinese: 这只鸟在三分钟内飞完了这段距离。

records.english: Up to now, Mr.
records.chinese: 到目前为止，……先生（注：原文本片段仅出现“Mr.”，完整姓氏Scott及后续内容未在本片段范围内）

records.english: Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
records.chinese: 到目前为止，斯科特先生从一家车库给另一家车库发了大量索取备件的请求和其他紧急讯息。

records.english: In this way, he has begun his own private ‘telephone’ service.
records.chinese: 就这样，他创办了自己的私人“电话”服务。

records.english: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.
records.chinese: 我刚搬进了大桥街的一栋房子。

records.english: Yesterday a beggar knocked at my door.
records.chinese: 昨天有个乞丐敲我的门。

records.english: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
records.chinese: 他向我要了一顿饭和一杯啤酒。

records.english: In return for this, the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
records.chinese: 作为回报，那乞丐倒立着唱歌。

records.english: I gave him a meal.
records.chinese: 我给了他一顿饭。

records.english: He ate the food and drank the beer.
records.chinese: 他吃了食物，喝了啤酒。

records.english: Then he put a piece of cheese in his pocket and went away.
records.chinese: 然后他把一块奶酪放进口袋，就走了。

records.english: Later a neighbour told me about him.
records.chinese: 后来一个邻居告诉我他的事。

records.english: Everybody knows him.
records.chinese: 人人都认识他。

records.english: His name is Percy Buttons.
records.chinese: 他的名字叫珀西·巴顿斯。

records.english: He calls at every house in the street once a month and always asks for a meal and a glass of beer.
records.chinese: 他每月登门拜访这条街上的每一户人家一次，而且总是讨要一顿饭和一杯啤酒。

records.english: The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
records.chinese: 飞机晚点了，侦探们整个上午都在机场等候。

records.english: They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa.
records.chinese: 他们正期待着一个来自南非、装有钻石的贵重包裹。

records.english: A few hours earlier,
records.chinese: 几小时前，

records.english: someone had told the police that thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
records.chinese: 之前已经有人告诉警方，小偷会试图偷那些钻石。

records.english: When the plane arrived, some of the detectives were waiting inside the main building while others were waiting on the airfield.
records.chinese: 飞机抵达时，一些侦探在主楼内等待，另一些人在机场等候。

records.english: Two men took the parcel off the plane and carried it into the Customs House.
records.chinese: 两个人把包裹从飞机上取下，带进了海关大楼。

records.english: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door, two others opened the parcel.
records.chinese: 两名警探在门口值守的时候，另外两人打开了包裹。

records.english: To their surprise, the precious parcel was full of stones and sand!
records.chinese: 令他们惊讶的是，贵重包裹里满是石头和沙子！

records.english: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
records.chinese: 乔·桑德斯拥有我们镇上最美丽的花园
records.lesson: Lesson 8 The best and the worst

records.english: Nearly everybody enters for ‘The Nicest Garden Competition’ each year, but Joe wins every time.
records.chinese: 几乎人人每年都参加「最美花园竞赛」，但乔每次都赢。
records.lesson: Lesson 8 The best and the worst

records.english: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
records.chinese: 比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的大。
records.lesson: Lesson 8 The best and the worst

records.english: Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables, but Joe's garden is more interesting.
records.chinese: 比尔干活比乔更卖力，种的花和蔬菜也更多，但乔的花园更有意思。
records.lesson: Lesson 8 The best and the worst

records.english: He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
records.chinese: 他铺了整洁的小径，还在池塘上修了一座木桥。
records.lesson: Lesson 8 The best and the worst

records.english: I like gardens too, but I do not like hard work.
records.chinese: 我也喜欢花园，但我不喜欢辛苦的劳作。
records.lesson: Lesson 8 The best and the worst

records.english: Every year I enter for the garden competition too, and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
records.chinese: 每年我也参加园艺比赛，而且我总能因为城里最糟糕的花园获得一个小奖！
records.lesson: Lesson 8 The best and the worst

records.english: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
records.chinese: 星期三晚上，我们去了市政厅。

records.english: It was the last day of the year and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.
records.chinese: 那是一年中的最后一天，一大群人已经聚集在市政厅的大钟下面。

records.english: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
records.chinese: 再过二十分钟，它就会敲十二下了。

records.english: Fifteen minutes passed and then, at five to twelve, the clock stopped.
records.chinese: 十五分钟过去了，接着在十一点五十五分的时候，钟停了。

records.english: The big minute hand did not move.
records.chinese: 那根大分针没有动。

records.english: We waited and waited, but nothing happened.
records.chinese: 我们等啊等，可是什么事都没发生。

records.english: Suddenly someone shouted, ‘It's two minutes past twelve!
records.chinese: 突然有人大喊：“现在是十二点过两分！”

records.english: The clock has stopped!’
records.chinese: 钟停了！

records.english: I looked at my watch.
records.chinese: 我看了看我的手表。

records.english: It was true.
records.chinese: 这是真的。

records.english: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.
records.chinese: 那座大钟不肯迎接新年。

records.english: At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.
records.chinese: 在那一刻，每个人都开始笑和唱歌。

records.english: We have an old musical instrument.
records.chinese: 我们有一件古老的乐器。它被称作击弦古钢琴（clavichord）。

records.english: It is called a clavichord.
records.chinese: 它被称作古钢琴（击弦古钢琴）。

records.english: It was made in Germany in 1681.
records.chinese: 它是1681年在德国制造的。

records.english: Our clavichord is kept in the living-room.
records.chinese: 我们的击弦古钢琴被放在客厅里。

records.english: It has belonged to our family for a long time.
records.chinese: 它已经属于我们家族很长时间了

records.english: The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.
records.chinese: 这件乐器是我祖父多年前买的

records.english: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
records.chinese: 最近它被一位访客损坏了。

records.english: She tried to play jazz on it!
records.chinese: 她试着在那架乐器上演奏爵士乐！

records.english: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.
records.chinese: 她按键太用力，结果有两根琴弦断了。

records.english: My father was shocked.
records.chinese: 我父亲感到震惊。

records.english: Now we are not allowed to touch it.
records.chinese: 现在不允许我们碰它。

records.english: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
records.chinese: 它正在被我父亲的一位朋友修理。

records.english: I was having dinner at a restaurant when Tony Steele came in.
records.chinese: 我正在一家餐馆吃晚饭，这时托尼·斯蒂尔走了进来。
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: Tony worked in a lawyer's office years ago, but he is now working at a bank.
records.chinese: 托尼几年前在一家律师事务所工作，但他现在在一家银行上班。
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: He gets a good salary, but he always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back.
records.chinese: 他薪水很高，但他总是向朋友借钱，而且从来不还。
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: Tony saw me and came and sat at the same table.
records.chinese: 托尼看见我，走过来并坐在同一张桌子旁。
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: He has never borrowed money from me.
records.chinese: 他从未向我借过钱。
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.
records.chinese: 他吃饭的时候，我请他借给我二十英镑。
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: To my surprise, he gave me the money immediately.
records.chinese: 令我惊讶的是，他立刻把这笔钱给了我。
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: ‘I have never borrowed any money from you,’ Tony said, ‘so now you can pay for my dinner!’
records.chinese: “我从来没向你借过钱，”托尼说，“所以现在你可以付我的饭钱了！”
records.lesson: Lesson 11 One good turn deserves another

records.english: Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.
records.chinese: 我们的邻居查尔斯·艾莉森船长明天将从朴次茅斯启航。

records.english: We'll meet him at the harbour early in the morning.
records.chinese: 我们将一大早在港口和他碰面。

records.english: He will be in his small boat, Topsail.
records.chinese: 他会在他的小船“托普赛号”上。

records.english: Topsail is a famous little boat.
records.chinese: 托普赛是一艘著名的小船

records.english: It has sailed across the Atlantic many times.
records.chinese: 它已经多次横渡大西洋。

records.english: Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock, so we'll have plenty of time.
records.chinese: 艾莉森船长将于八点出发，所以我们的时间很充裕。

records.english: We'll see him off.
records.chinese: 我们将为他送行。

records.english: He will take part in an important race across the Atlantic.
records.chinese: 他将参加一场横跨大西洋的重要比赛。

records.english: The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
records.chinese: “格林伍德男孩”是一群流行歌手。

records.english: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
records.chinese: 目前，他们正在访问全国各地。

records.english: They will be arriving here tomorrow.
records.chinese: 他们明天将抵达这里。

records.english: They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
records.chinese: 他们将乘火车来，镇上的大部分年轻人会到车站迎接他们。

records.english: Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club.
records.chinese: 明晚他们将在工人俱乐部演唱。

records.english: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.
records.chinese: 格林伍德男孩乐队将停留五天。

records.english: During this time, they will give five performances.
records.chinese: 在此期间，他们将进行五次表演。

records.english: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.
records.chinese: 和往常一样，警方会遇到难办的局面。

records.english: They will be trying to keep order.
records.chinese: 他们会试图维持秩序

records.english: It is always the same on these occasions.
records.chinese: 在这些场合，情况总是一样的。

records.english: I had an amusing experience last year.
records.chinese: 去年我有过一次有趣的经历。

records.english: After I had left a small village in the south of France,
records.chinese: 在我离开法国南部的一个小村庄之后，

records.english: I drove on to the next town.
records.chinese: 我继续开车前往下一个城镇。

records.english: On the way, a young man waved to me.
records.chinese: 途中，一个年轻人向我挥了挥手。

records.english: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
records.chinese: 我停了下来，接着他向我提出搭便车的请求。

records.english: As soon as he had got into the car, I said good morning to him in French and he replied in the same language.
records.chinese: 他一上车，我就用法语向他道早安，他也用同样的语言回答。

records.english: Apart from a few words, I do not know any French at all.
records.chinese: 除了几个词以外，我一点法语都不懂。

records.english: Neither of us spoke during the journey.
records.chinese: 我们两人在旅途中都没说话。

records.english: I had nearly reached the town, when the young man suddenly said, very slowly, ‘Do you speak English?’
records.chinese: 我快到镇上时，那个年轻人突然开口，慢吞吞地说：「你会讲英语吗？」

records.english: As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
records.chinese: 正如我很快就发觉的那样，他本人就是英国人！

records.english: The secretary told me that Mr.
records.chinese: 秘书告诉我，哈姆斯沃思先生要见我。（注：本句记录截取到Mr.，完整原句后接Harmsworth would see me）

records.english: Harmsworth would see me.
records.chinese: 哈姆斯沃斯先生将会见我。

records.english: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.
records.chinese: 我走进他的办公室时，觉得非常紧张。

records.english: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
records.chinese: 我进去的时候，他连头都没从写字台上抬起来。

records.english: After I had sat down, he said that business was very bad.
records.chinese: 我坐下之后，他说生意很不景气。

records.english: He told me that the firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
records.chinese: 他告诉我，公司付不起这么大数额的工资。

records.english: Twenty people had already left.
records.chinese: 二十个人已经离开了。

records.english: I knew that my turn had come.
records.chinese: 我知道轮到我了。

records.english: ‘Mr.
records.chinese: “先生

records.english: Harmsworth,’ I said in a weak voice.
records.chinese: ‘哈姆斯沃思，’我声音微弱地说道。

records.english: ‘Don't interrupt,’ he said.
records.chinese: “别打断，”他说道。

records.english: Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year!
records.chinese: 然后他笑了笑，告诉我我每年会多得一千英镑！

records.english: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon find it.
records.chinese: 如果你把车停在错误的地方，交通警察很快就会发现它。

records.english: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
records.chinese: 如果他不给你开罚单就放你走，你会很走运的。

records.english: However, this does not always happen.
records.chinese: 然而，这种情况并不总是发生。

records.english: Traffic police are sometimes very polite.
records.chinese: 交通警察有时很有礼貌。

records.english: During a holiday in Sweden,
records.chinese: 在瑞典度假期间，

records.english: I found this note on my car: ‘Sir,
records.chinese: 我在我的车上发现了这个便条：“先生，

records.english: we welcome you to our city.
records.chinese: 我们欢迎你来到我们的城市。

records.english: This is a "No Parking" area.
records.chinese: 这里是“禁止停车”区域。

records.english: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs.
records.chinese: 如果你注意我们的街牌，你会在这里过得愉快。

records.english: This note is only a reminder.’
records.chinese: “这张字条只是一个提醒。”

records.english: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
records.chinese: 如果你收到这样的请求，你一定得服从它！

records.english: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.
records.chinese: 我的阿姨詹妮弗是一名女演员。

records.english: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
records.chinese: 她肯定至少有三十五岁了。

records.english: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
records.chinese: 尽管如此，她经常作为年轻女孩出现在舞台上。

records.english: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
records.chinese: 珍妮弗很快就要参加一部新剧的演出了。

records.english: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.
records.chinese: 这一次，她将扮演一个十七岁的女孩。

records.english: In the play,
records.chinese: 在剧中，

records.english: she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
records.chinese: 她必须穿着亮红色的连衣裙和黑色长袜出场。

records.english: Last year, in another play, she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
records.chinese: 去年，在另一部戏里，她不得不穿短袜和一条鲜艳的橙色连衣裙。

records.english: If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers, ‘Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!’
records.chinese: 如果有人问她多大年纪，她总是回答：「亲爱的，长大成人一定很可怕！」

records.english: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
records.chinese: 我在一家乡村小酒馆吃完午饭后，找了我的包。

records.english: I had left it on a chair beside the door and now it wasn't there!
records.chinese: 我之前把它落在门边的椅子上，可现在它不在那儿了！

records.english: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.
records.chinese: 就在我找它的时候，房东走了进来。

records.english: ‘Did you have a good meal?’ he asked.
records.chinese: “你吃得好吗？”他问道。

records.english: ‘Yes, thank you,’ I answered, ‘but I can't pay the bill.
records.chinese: “是的，谢谢你，”我回答道，“可我付不起账单。”

records.english: I haven't got my bag.’
records.chinese: “我没带我的包。”

records.english: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.
records.chinese: 房东笑了笑，立刻出去了。

records.english: In a few minutes he returned with my bag and gave it back to me.
records.chinese: 几分钟后，他带着我的包回来，把它还给了我。

records.english: ‘I'm very sorry,’ he said.
records.chinese: “我很抱歉，”他说道。

records.english: ‘My dog had taken it into the garden.
records.chinese: “我的狗把它带到花园里了。”

records.english: He often does this!’
records.chinese: 他经常这样做！’

records.english: The play may begin at any moment, I said.
records.chinese: “戏随时都可能开演，”我说。

records.english: ‘It may have begun already,’ Susan answered.
records.chinese: “它可能已经开始了，”苏珊回答道。

records.english: I hurried to the ticket office.
records.chinese: 我匆忙赶到售票处。

records.english: ‘May I have two tickets please?’ I asked.
records.chinese: “请问能给我两张票吗？”我问道。

records.english: ‘I'm sorry, we've sold out,’ the girl said.
records.chinese: “对不起，我们已经卖光了。” 女孩说道。

records.english: ‘What a pity!’ Susan exclaimed.
records.chinese: “真可惜！”苏珊喊道。

records.english: Just then, a man hurried to the ticket office.
records.chinese: 就在这时，一个男人匆匆赶到售票处。

records.english: ‘Can I return these two tickets?’ he asked.
records.chinese: “我能退这两张票吗？”他问道。

records.english: ‘Certainly,’ the girl said.
records.chinese: 「当然可以，」女孩说。

records.english: I went back to the ticket office at once.
records.chinese: 我立刻回到了售票处。

records.english: ‘Could I have those two tickets please?’ I asked.
records.chinese: “能给我那两张票吗？”我问道。

records.english: ‘Certainly,’ the girl said, ‘but they are for next Wednesday's performance.
records.chinese: “当然可以，”女孩说，“不过这两张是下周三演出的票。”

records.english: Do you still want them?’
records.chinese: “你还想要它们吗？”

records.english: ‘I might as well have them,’ I said sadly.
records.chinese: 「我还是买这两张吧，」我沮丧地说。

records.english: Fishing is my favourite sport.
records.chinese: 钓鱼是我最喜欢的运动。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: I often fish for hours without catching anything.
records.chinese: 我经常一钓就是好几个小时，却什么也钓不到。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: But this does not worry me.
records.chinese: 但这并不让我担心。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: Some fishermen are unlucky.
records.chinese: 有些渔民运气不好。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and rubbish.
records.chinese: 他们没钓到鱼，反倒捞上来旧靴子和垃圾。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: I am even less lucky.
records.chinese: 我甚至更不走运。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: I never catch anything — not even old boots.
records.chinese: 我从来什么都钓不到——连旧靴子也钓不到。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
records.chinese: 在河边耗了整整一上午之后，我总是拎着空包回家。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: My friends say, ‘It's a waste of time!’
records.chinese: 我的朋友们说：“这是浪费时间！”
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: But they don't realize one important thing.
records.chinese: 但他们没有意识到一件重要的事。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: I am not really interested in fishing.
records.chinese: 我其实对钓鱼并不感兴趣。
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!
records.chinese: 我只对坐在船上、什么都不做感兴趣！
records.lesson: Lesson 20 One man in a boat

records.english: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.
records.chinese: 飞机正慢慢把我逼疯。

records.english: I live near an airport and passing planes can be heard night and day.
records.chinese: 我住在机场附近，过往的飞机日日夜夜都能听得见。

records.english: The airport was built years ago,
records.chinese: 这座机场是多年前建造的，

records.english: but for some reason it could not be used then.
records.chinese: 但由于某种原因，它当时无法被使用。

records.english: Last year, however, it came into use.
records.chinese: 然而，去年它投入使用了。

records.english: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.
records.chinese: 一定有一百多人被噪音逼得离开了自己的家。

records.english: I am one of the few people left.
records.chinese: 我是剩下的少数人之一。

records.english: Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane.
records.chinese: 有时我觉得这栋房子会被一架路过的飞机撞倒。

records.english: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away,
records.chinese: 有人曾向我提供一大笔钱让我搬走，

records.english: but I am determined to stay here.
records.chinese: 但我决心留在这里。

records.english: Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right.
records.chinese: 大家都说我一定是疯了，而且他们很可能是对的。

records.english: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
records.chinese: 我的女儿简从未想过会收到荷兰一位同龄女孩的来信。

records.english: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle.
records.chinese: 去年，我们横渡英吉利海峡时，简把一张写有她姓名和地址的纸条装进了瓶子里。

records.english: She threw the bottle into the sea.
records.chinese: 她把瓶子扔进了海里。

records.english: She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland.
records.chinese: 她再也没有想过这件事，但十个月后，她收到了一封来自荷兰一个女孩的信。

records.english: Both girls write to each other regularly now.
records.chinese: 两个女孩现在都经常互相写信。

records.english: However, they have decided to use the post office.
records.chinese: 不过，她们决定使用邮局。

records.english: Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
records.chinese: 信件会贵一点，但肯定会更快送达。

records.english: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.
records.chinese: 我昨天收到了姐姐寄来的一封信。

records.english: She lives in Nigeria.
records.chinese: 她住在尼日利亚。

records.english: In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.
records.chinese: 在信里，她说她明年会来英国。

records.english: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
records.chinese: 如果她来，她会大吃一惊。

records.english: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
records.chinese: 我们现在住在乡下一栋漂亮的新房子里。

records.english: Work on it had begun before my sister left.
records.chinese: 这项工作在我姐姐离开之前就已经开始了。

records.english: The house was completed five months ago.
records.chinese: 这座房子是五个月前建成的。

records.english: In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us.
records.chinese: 在我的信里，我告诉她她可以和我们住在一起。

records.english: The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.
records.chinese: 这栋房子有许多大房间，还有一个很漂亮的花园。

records.english: It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people.
records.chinese: 这是一栋非常现代的房子，所以在有些人看来它显得很奇怪。

records.english: It must be the only modern house in the district.
records.chinese: 这肯定是这个地区唯一的现代化住宅。

records.english: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
records.chinese: 我走进酒店经理的办公室，坐了下来。

records.english: I had just lost £50 and I felt very upset.
records.chinese: 我刚丢了50英镑，心里特别难受。

records.english: ‘I left the money in my room,’ I said, ‘and it's not there now.’
records.chinese: “我把钱落在房间里了，”我说，“可现在它不在那儿了。”

records.english: The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
records.chinese: 经理很同情，但他什么也做不了。

records.english: ‘Everyone's losing money these days,’ he said.
records.chinese: “这些日子大家都在赔钱，”他说。

records.english: He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
records.chinese: 他开始抱怨这个世道险恶，但话被一阵敲门声打断了。

records.english: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.
records.chinese: 一个女孩走了进来，把一个信封放在了他的桌上。

records.english: It contained £50.
records.chinese: 它里面装有50英镑。

records.english: ‘I found this outside this gentleman's room,’ she said.
records.chinese: “我是在这位先生的房间外面发现这个的，”她说道。

records.english: ‘Well,’ I said to the manager, ‘there is still some honesty in this world!’
records.chinese: “是啊，”我对经理说，“这世上还是有诚实可言的！”

records.english: I arrived in London at last.
records.chinese: 我终于抵达了伦敦。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: The railway station was big, black and dark.
records.chinese: 火车站又大又黑又暗。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.
records.chinese: 我不知道去我住的旅馆的路，所以问了一个搬运工。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
records.chinese: 我不仅讲英语讲得非常小心，而且也讲得非常清楚。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: The porter, however, could not understand me.
records.chinese: 可是那个搬运工听不懂我的话。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: I repeated my question several times and at last he understood.
records.chinese: 我把我的问题重复了好几次，最后他听懂了。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: He answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
records.chinese: 他回答了我，但他说得既不慢也不清楚。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: ‘I am a foreigner,’ I said.
records.chinese: “我是外国人。”我说道。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him.
records.chinese: 然后他说得很慢，但我听不懂他的话。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: My teacher never spoke English like that!
records.chinese: 我的老师从来不会像那样说英语！
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.
records.chinese: 搬运工和我对视了一眼，然后笑了。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: Then he said something and I understood it.
records.chinese: 然后他说了些什么，我听懂了。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: ‘You'll soon learn English!’ he said.
records.chinese: “你很快就会学会英语的！”他说。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: I wonder.
records.chinese: 我感到疑惑。（针对前文“你很快就能学会英语”的说法，省略了具体疑惑的内容）
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: In England, each person speaks a different dialect.
records.chinese: 在英格兰，每个人说的方言都不一样。
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them!
records.chinese: 英国人彼此听得懂对方的话，可我听不懂他们说的！
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: Do they speak English?
records.chinese: 他们说英语吗？
records.lesson: Lesson 25 Do the English speak English?

records.english: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
records.chinese: 我是一名美术专业的学生，我画很多画。

records.english: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
records.chinese: 许多人假装他们了解现代艺术。

records.english: They always tell you what a picture is ‘about’.
records.chinese: 他们总是告诉你一幅画“讲的是什么”。

records.english: Of course, many pictures are not ‘about’ anything.
records.chinese: 当然，许多画并不是“关于”什么内容的。

records.english: They are just pretty patterns.
records.chinese: 它们只不过是好看的图案而已。

records.english: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
records.chinese: 我们喜欢它们，就像我们喜欢漂亮的窗帘布料一样。

records.english: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else.
records.chinese: 我认为，幼儿往往比其他任何人都更懂得欣赏现代绘画。

records.english: They notice more.
records.chinese: 他们注意到更多。

records.english: My sister is only seven, but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
records.chinese: 我妹妹才七岁，可她总对我说我的画好不好看。

records.english: She came into my room yesterday.
records.chinese: 她昨天进了我的房间。

records.english: ‘What are you doing?’ she asked.
records.chinese: “你在做什么？”她问道。

records.english: ‘I'm hanging this picture on the wall,’ I answered.
records.chinese: “我正把这幅画挂到墙上去，”我回答道。

records.english: ‘It's a new one.
records.chinese: “这是一幅新的（画）。”

records.english: Do you like it?’
records.chinese: “你喜欢它吗？”

records.english: She looked at it critically for a moment.
records.chinese: 她以挑剔/审视的目光端详了它好一会儿。

records.english: ‘It's all right,’ she said, ‘but isn't it upside down?’
records.chinese: “没关系，”她说，“但它难道不是挂倒了吗？”

records.english: I looked at it again.
records.chinese: 我又看了一遍。

records.english: She was right!
records.chinese: 她说得对！

records.english: It was!
records.chinese: 确实是这样！（这是呼应前一句的省略强调片段，指前文提到的情况当时确实成立）

records.english: Late in the afternoon,
records.chinese: 傍晚时分，

records.english: the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
records.chinese: 男孩们在田地中间搭起了他们的帐篷。

records.english: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
records.chinese: 这件事刚做完，他们就架起篝火煮了一顿饭。

records.english: They were all hungry and the food smelt good.
records.chinese: 他们都饿了，而且食物闻起来很香。

records.english: After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the camp fire.
records.chinese: 美餐一顿之后，他们在营火旁讲故事、唱歌。

records.english: But some time later it began to rain.
records.chinese: 可过了一段时间，天开始下雨了。

records.english: The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
records.chinese: 男孩们感到疲倦，所以他们扑灭了火，悄悄钻进了他们的帐篷。

records.english: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.
records.chinese: 他们的睡袋温暖舒适，所以他们都睡得安稳。

records.english: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
records.chinese: 半夜时分，两个男孩醒了过来，开始大喊大叫。

records.english: The tent was full of water!
records.chinese: 帐篷里满是水！

records.english: They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
records.chinese: 他们全都从睡袋里跳了出来，急忙跑到外面。

records.english: It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field.
records.chinese: 雨下得很大，他们发现田里形成了一条小溪。

records.english: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
records.chinese: 这条小溪蜿蜒穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷底下流过！

records.english: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.
records.chinese: 贾斯珀·怀特是少有的相信古代神话的人之一。

records.english: He has just bought a new house in the city,
records.chinese: 他刚在城里买了一栋新房子，

records.english: but ever since he moved in,
records.chinese: 可自从他搬进去以来，

records.english: he has had trouble with cars and their owners.
records.chinese: 他一直被汽车和车主们搅得不得安生。

records.english: When he returns home at night,
records.chinese: 当他晚上回到家时，（本句为时间状语从句片段，需依附主句才有完整含义）

records.english: he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.
records.chinese: 他总是发现有人把一辆车停在了他家大门外。

records.english: Because of this,
records.chinese: 因为这个缘故，

records.english: he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
records.chinese: 他甚至一次都没能把自己的车开进车库。

records.english: Jasper has put up ‘No Parking’ signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect.
records.chinese: 贾斯珀在自家大门外张贴了“禁止停车”的标志，但这些标志丝毫没有起作用。

records.english: Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate.
records.chinese: 现在他把一个丑陋的石头脑袋安在了大门上方。

records.english: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
records.chinese: 这是我见过的最丑陋的面孔之一。

records.english: I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon.
records.chinese: 我问他那是什么，他告诉我那是戈耳工之一的美杜莎。

records.english: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.
records.chinese: 贾斯珀希望她能把汽车和车主们变成石头。

records.english: But none of them have been turned to stone yet!
records.chinese: 但他们当中还没有一个人被变成石头呢！

records.english: Captain Ben Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi and has begun a new service.
records.chinese: 本·福西特上尉买了一辆不同寻常的出租车，并且已经开始了一项新业务。

records.english: The taxi is a small Swiss aeroplane called a Pilatus Porter.
records.chinese: 这架“出租车”是一架小型瑞士飞机，名叫皮拉图斯·波特号。

records.english: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.
records.chinese: 这架很棒的飞机可以搭载七名乘客。

records.english: The most surprising thing about it, however, is that it can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field.
records.chinese: 不过，最令人惊奇的一点是，它能在任何地方降落：雪地上、水面上，甚至刚耕过的田地里。

records.english: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains.
records.chinese: 福西特上尉的第一位乘客是一名医生，他从伯明翰飞往威尔士山区一个偏僻的村庄。

records.english: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
records.chinese: 从那时起，福西特上尉就已经用飞机运送乘客到许多不同寻常的地方。

records.english: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats and on another occasion,
records.chinese: 有一次他降落在一栋公寓楼的屋顶上，还有一次，（后文接另一次降落的具体情况）

records.english: he landed in a deserted car park.
records.chinese: 他降落在一个废弃的停车场里。

records.english: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request from a businessman.
records.chinese: 福西特上尉刚刚拒绝了一位商人提出的奇怪要求。

records.english: The man wanted to fly to Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean, but Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
records.chinese: 那个人想飞往罗科尔——大西洋上的一座孤岛，但福西特机长没有载他去，因为这趟行程太危险了。

records.english: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park near my home.
records.chinese: 韦勒河是一条横穿我家附近公园的小河。

records.english: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
records.chinese: 我喜欢在天气晴朗的午后坐在韦尔河边上。

records.english: It was warm last Sunday, so I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
records.chinese: 上星期天天气很暖和，所以我像往常一样去了，坐在河岸上。

records.english: Some children were playing games on the bank and there were some people rowing on the river.
records.chinese: 一些孩子正在河岸上玩游戏，河面上有一些人在划船。

records.english: Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard and it went towards a passing boat.
records.chinese: 突然，其中一个孩子狠狠踢了一脚球，球便朝一艘正在驶过的小船飞去。

records.english: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat,
records.chinese: 岸上的一些人冲着船上的人喊道，（本句为片段，完整句后接转折分句“但他没听见他们的话”）

records.english: but he did not hear them.
records.chinese: 但他没有听到他们（的喊声）。

records.english: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
records.chinese: 球重重地打中了他，使他差点掉进水里。

records.english: I turned to look at the children,
records.chinese: 我转过身去看孩子们，

records.english: but there weren't any in sight: they had all run away!
records.chinese: 可一个也看不见：他们全都跑开了！不对，修正为“但是一个也看不见：他们全都跑开了！”

records.english: The man laughed when he realized what had happened.
records.chinese: 那男人意识到发生了什么事，就笑了起来。

records.english: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.
records.chinese: 他冲孩子们大声喊，然后把球扔回了岸边。

records.english: Yesterday afternoon Frank Hawkins was telling me about his experiences as a young man.
records.chinese: 昨天下午，弗兰克·霍金斯正跟我讲他年轻时的经历。

records.english: Before he retired, Frank was the head of a very large business company, but as a boy he used to work in a small shop.
records.chinese: 退休前，弗兰克是一家大型商业公司的负责人；但他小时候曾在一家小商店工作。

records.english: It was his job to repair bicycles and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
records.chinese: 修理自行车曾是他的工作，而且在那段时期他常常一天工作十四个小时。

records.english: He saved money for years and in 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
records.chinese: 他攒了多年的钱，1958年他买下了一间属于自己的小车间。

records.english: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
records.chinese: 二十多岁时，弗兰克曾为飞机制造零配件。

records.english: At that time he had two helpers.
records.chinese: 当时他有两个帮手。

records.english: In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory which employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people.
records.chinese: 几年之后，这家小作坊变成了一家雇有728人的大工厂。

records.english: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
records.chinese: 弗兰克想起自己早年的艰苦岁月和通往成功的漫漫长路时，笑了。

records.english: He was still smiling when the door opened and his wife came in.
records.chinese: 他正依旧笑着，这时门开了，他的妻子走了进来。

records.english: She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
records.chinese: 她想让他去修理他们孙子的自行车！

records.english: People are not so honest as they once were.
records.chinese: 人们并不像过去那样诚实了。

records.english: The temptation to steal is greater than ever before — especially in large shops.
records.chinese: 偷窃的诱惑比以往任何时候都大——尤其是在大型商店里。

records.english: A detective recently watched a well-dressed woman who always went into a large store on Monday mornings.
records.chinese: 一名侦探最近观察了一位穿着考究的女士，她总是在星期一上午走进一家大商店。

records.english: One Monday, there were fewer people in the shop than usual when the woman came in, so it was easier for the detective to watch her.
records.chinese: 有一个星期一，那位妇女进来的时候，店里的人比平时少，因此侦探更容易监视她。

records.english: The woman first bought a few small articles.
records.chinese: 这位妇女首先买了几件小商品。

records.english: After a little while, she chose an expensive dress.
records.chinese: 过了一小会儿，她挑了一件昂贵的连衣裙。

records.english: She handed it to an assistant who wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible.
records.chinese: 她把它交给一位助理，那位助理尽快为她把它包好了。

records.english: Then the woman simply took the parcel and walked out of the shop without paying.
records.chinese: 随后那个女人干脆拿了包裹，没付钱就走出了商店。

records.english: When she was arrested,
records.chinese: 当她被捕时，

records.english: the detective found out that the shop assistant was her daughter.
records.chinese: 侦探查明那位店员是她的女儿。

records.english: The girl gave her mother a free dress once a week!
records.chinese: 这个女孩每周给她妈妈一件免费的连衣裙！

records.english: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
records.chinese: 过了将近一周，女孩才得以说明自己遭遇了什么。

records.english: One afternoon she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm.
records.chinese: 一天下午，她乘小船从海岸出发，遇上了暴风雨。

records.english: During the night, the boat was badly damaged and the girl jumped into the sea.
records.chinese: 夜里，船严重受损，女孩跳进了海里。

records.english: She swam for miles and miles, and then she saw a light.
records.chinese: 她游了一程又一程，好几英里远，然后她看见了一盏灯光。

records.english: She swam towards it, but the light disappeared.
records.chinese: 她朝那束光游去，但光线消失了。

records.english: She swam on and on.
records.chinese: 她不停地游啊游。

records.english: When she woke up the next morning, she found herself in a hospital.
records.chinese: 第二天早上她醒来时，发现自己在一家医院里。

records.english: Dan Robinson has been worried all week.
records.chinese: 丹·鲁滨逊整个星期都忧心忡忡。

records.english: Last Tuesday he received a letter from the local police.
records.chinese: 上周二他收到了当地警方寄来的一封信。

records.english: In the letter, he was asked to call at the station.
records.chinese: 在这封信里，他被要求到警察局去一趟。

records.english: Dan wondered why he was wanted by the police,
records.chinese: 丹想知道自己为什么会被警方找，

records.english: but he went to the station yesterday and now he is not worried any more.
records.chinese: 但他昨天去了警察局，现在已经不再担心了。

records.english: At the station,
records.chinese: 在车站，

records.english: he was told by a smiling policeman that his bicycle had been found.
records.chinese: 一名面带微笑的警察告诉他，他的自行车已经被找到了。

records.english: Five days ago,
records.chinese: 五天前，

records.english: the policeman told him,
records.chinese: 警察告诉他，

records.english: the bicycle was picked up in a small village four hundred miles away.
records.chinese: 那辆自行车是在四百英里外的一个小村庄里发现的。

records.english: It is now being sent to his home by train.
records.chinese: 它现在正由火车送往他的家。

records.english: Dan was most surprised when he heard the news.
records.chinese: 丹听到这个消息时极为惊讶。

records.english: He was amused too, because he never expected the bicycle to be found.
records.chinese: 他也觉得好笑，因为他从来没指望这辆自行车能被找回来。

records.english: It was stolen twenty years ago when Dan was a boy of fifteen!
records.chinese: 那是二十年前丹还是个十五岁男孩的时候被偷走的！

records.english: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
records.chinese: 罗伊·特伦顿以前是开出租车的。

records.english: A short while ago, however, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it.
records.chinese: 然而，就在不久前，他成了一名公共汽车司机，并且对此一直不后悔。

records.english: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
records.chinese: 他觉得自己的新工作要令人兴奋得多。

records.english: When he was driving along Catford Street recently,
records.chinese: 当他最近驾车沿凯特福德街行驶时，（本句为时间状语从句片段，修饰后续主句的事件时间）

records.english: he saw two thieves rush out of a shop and run towards a waiting car.
records.chinese: 他看见两个小偷从一家商店冲出来，朝一辆等候着的汽车跑去。

records.english: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
records.chinese: 其中一人正提着一个装满钱的袋子。

records.english: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
records.chinese: 罗伊行动迅速，开着公交车径直朝小偷冲去。

records.english: The car with the thieves was going fast, but Roy drove his bus into the back of it.
records.chinese: 载着小偷的汽车开得很快，但罗伊开着公交车撞上了它的尾部。

records.english: While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
records.chinese: 那辆撞坏的车继续驶离时，罗伊停下公交车，给警方打了电话。

records.english: The thieves' car was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
records.chinese: 小偷的汽车损坏严重，很容易辨认出来。

records.english: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
records.chinese: 不久之后，警察拦下了汽车，两名男子都被捕了。

records.english: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
records.chinese: 黛比·哈特打算明天游过英吉利海峡。

records.english: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
records.chinese: 她打算早晨五点从法国海岸出发。

records.english: Debbie is only eleven years old and she hopes to set up a new world record.
records.chinese: 黛比才十一岁，她希望创造一项新的世界纪录。

records.english: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
records.chinese: 她是一名实力很强的游泳选手，许多人认为她一定会成功。

records.english: Her father will set out with her in a small boat.
records.chinese: 她的父亲将乘一条小船和她一起出发。

records.english: Mr.
records.chinese: 先生（后接姓氏哈特）。

records.english: Hart has trained his daughter for years.
records.chinese: 哈特先生已经训练自己的女儿多年。

records.english: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
records.chinese: 明天，当她长距离游向英国时，他将焦急地注视着她。

records.english: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
records.chinese: 黛比打算每隔两小时短暂休息一下。

records.english: She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
records.chinese: 她会喝点东西，但不会吃任何固体食物。

records.english: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
records.chinese: 黛比的大多数同学届时将在英国海岸等候她。

records.english: Among them will be Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
records.chinese: 等候的人中将有黛比的母亲，她年轻时也曾亲自游过英吉利海峡。

records.english: The Olympic Games will be held in our country in four years' time.
records.chinese: 奥林匹克运动会将在四年后在我国举行。

records.english: As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels, an immense stadium, and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool.
records.chinese: 由于将有许多人来我国参观，政府将建设新旅馆、一座巨大的体育场和一个符合奥运标准的游泳池。

records.english: They will also be building new roads and a special railway line.
records.chinese: 他们还将建设新公路和一条专用铁路线。

records.english: The Games will be held just outside the capital and the whole area will be called ‘Olympic City’.
records.chinese: 运动会将在首都近郊举行，整片区域将被称为“奥林匹克城”。

records.english: Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
records.chinese: 到今年年底，工人们将已完成新公路的建设。

records.english: By the end of next year,
records.chinese: 到明年年底为止，

records.english: they will have finished work on the new stadium.
records.chinese: 他们将已完成新体育场的工程。

records.english: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter.
records.chinese: 这些宏伟的现代建筑已经由库尔特·冈特设计完成。

records.english: Everybody will be watching anxiously as the new buildings go up.
records.chinese: 随着新建筑逐渐建起，大家都将焦急地关注着。

records.english: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games because they have never been held before in this country.
records.chinese: 我们都很兴奋，盼望着奥运会，因为我国以前从未举办过。

records.english: My old friend, Harrison, had lived in the Mediterranean for many years before he returned to England.
records.chinese: 我的老朋友哈里森回英国之前，已经在地中海地区住了很多年。

records.english: He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country.
records.chinese: 他以前常梦想在英国退休，也曾计划在乡间定居。

records.english: He had no sooner returned than he bought a fine house and went to live there.
records.chinese: 他刚一回来，就买了一幢好房子，搬进去住了。

records.english: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather, for even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
records.chinese: 他几乎立刻就开始抱怨天气，因为虽然仍是夏天，却接连下雨，还常常冷得刺骨。

records.english: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock.
records.chinese: 在享受了这么多年阳光之后，哈里森大吃一惊。

records.english: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
records.chinese: 他的表现仿佛以前从未在英国住过一样。

records.english: In the end, he could not bear it any more.
records.chinese: 最后，他再也忍受不了了。

records.english: He sold his house and left the country.
records.chinese: 他卖掉了房子，离开了这个国家。

records.english: All the years he had lived abroad, he had forgotten all except the weather.
records.chinese: 在国外生活的那些年里，他忘记了一切，唯独没有忘记天气。

records.english: While John Gilbert was in hospital,
records.chinese: 约翰·吉尔伯特住院期间，（本句为时间状语从句片段，交代主句事件的时间背景）

records.english: he asked his doctor to tell him whether his operation had been successful,
records.chinese: 他请医生告诉他自己的手术是否成功，

records.english: but the doctor refused to do so.
records.chinese: 但医生拒绝这样做。

records.english: The following day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
records.chinese: 第二天，这位病人要了一部床边电话。

records.english: When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington.
records.chinese: 当他独自一人时，他给医院总机打了电话，并要求接通米林顿医生。

records.english: When the doctor answered the phone, Mr.
records.chinese: 当医生接听电话时，先生（称呼，后接姓氏，本句为片段）。

records.english: Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr John Gilbert.
records.chinese: 吉尔伯特说，他正在打听一位病人，一位叫约翰·吉尔伯特的先生。

records.english: He asked if Mr Gilbert's operation had been successful and the doctor told him that it had been.
records.chinese: 他问吉尔伯特先生的手术是否成功，医生告诉他手术是成功的。

records.english: He then asked when Mr Gilbert would be allowed to go home and the doctor told him that he would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks.
records.chinese: 接着他问吉尔伯特先生什么时候可以获准回家，医生告诉他还得在医院再住两周。

records.english: Then Dr Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient.
records.chinese: 接着米林顿医生询问打电话的人，他是不是那位病人的亲戚。

records.english: ‘No,’ the patient answered, ‘I am Mr John Gilbert.’
records.chinese: “不，”病人回答说，“我是约翰·吉尔伯特先生。”

records.english: Last week at a dinner-party, the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs Rumbold.
records.chinese: 上周在一次晚宴上，女主人让我坐在伦波尔德夫人旁边。

records.english: Mrs Rumbold was a large, unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
records.chinese: 伦博尔德太太是一位身材魁梧、面无笑容的女士，身着一件紧身黑连衣裙。

records.english: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
records.chinese: 我在她身旁坐下时，她甚至都没有抬头。

records.english: Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time,
records.chinese: 她的眼睛盯着自己的盘子，不一会儿，（为叙述片段，后续接她忙着吃东西的内容）

records.english: she was busy eating.
records.chinese: 她正忙着吃东西。

records.english: I tried to make conversation.
records.chinese: 我试着搭话。

records.english: ‘A new play is coming to "The Globe" soon,’ I said.
records.chinese: “有一出新戏很快要在‘环球剧场’上演了，”我说道。

records.english: ‘Will you be seeing it?’
records.chinese: “你会去看它吗？”

records.english: ‘No,’ she answered.
records.chinese: “不，”她回答道。

records.english: ‘Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year?’ I asked.
records.chinese: “你今年会在国外度假吗？”我问道。

records.english: ‘No,’ she answered.
records.chinese: “不，”她回答道。

records.english: ‘Will you be staying in England?’ I asked.
records.chinese: “你会留在英国吗？”我问道。

records.english: ‘No,’ she answered.
records.chinese: “不，”她回答道。

records.english: In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
records.chinese: 在绝望中，我问她是否吃得开心。

records.english: ‘Young man,’ she answered, ‘if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!’
records.chinese: “年轻人，”她回答道，“如果你多吃点、少说话，我们俩都会好好享用晚餐的！”

records.english: ‘Do you call that a hat?’ I said to my wife.
records.chinese: “你把那叫作帽子？”我对妻子说。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: ‘You needn't be so rude about it,’ my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
records.chinese: “你没必要说得这么无礼。”妻子一边照着镜子一边回答。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.
records.chinese: 我在一把有孔的现代式椅子上坐下来，等着。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour and my wife was still in front of the mirror.
records.chinese: 我们在帽子店里已经待了半小时，妻子却还在镜子前。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: ‘We mustn't buy things we don't need,’ I remarked suddenly.
records.chinese: “我们不能买不需要的东西。”我突然说道。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: I regretted saying it almost at once.
records.chinese: 话一出口，我几乎立刻就后悔了。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: ‘You needn't have said that,’ my wife said.
records.chinese: “你本不必那么说的。”妻子说。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: ‘I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.’
records.chinese: “我用不着提醒你，你昨天买的那条难看的领带吧。”
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: ‘I find it beautiful,’ I said.
records.chinese: “我觉得它很好看。”我说。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: ‘A man can never have too many ties.’
records.chinese: “男人的领带再多也不嫌多。”
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: ‘And a woman can't have too many hats,’ she answered.
records.chinese: “那么女人的帽子也再多不嫌多。”她回答。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
records.chinese: 十分钟后，我们一起走出了商店。
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
records.chinese: 妻子戴着一顶看起来像灯塔的帽子！
records.lesson: Lesson 41 Do you call that a hat?

records.english: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of Old Delhi,
records.chinese: 由于我们已在旧德里的一个市场里走了很长一段路，

records.english: we stopped at a square to have a rest.
records.chinese: 我们在一个广场停下来休息。

records.english: After a time,
records.chinese: 过了一会儿，

records.english: we noticed a snake-charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square,
records.chinese: 我们注意到广场另一边有个带着两只大篮子的耍蛇人，

records.english: so we went to have a look at him.
records.chinese: 于是我们走过去看了看他。

records.english: As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
records.chinese: 他一看见我们，就拿起一支镶着硬币的长笛，并打开了一个篮子。

records.english: When he began to play a tune, we had our first glimpse of the snake.
records.chinese: 当他开始吹奏一支曲子时，我们第一次瞥见了那条蛇。

records.english: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
records.chinese: 它从篮子里探起身子，开始随着笛子的移动而摆动。

records.english: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
records.chinese: 耍蛇人突然开始演奏爵士乐和现代流行歌曲，我们感到十分惊讶。

records.english: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.
records.chinese: 然而，那条蛇仍继续慢慢地“跳舞”。

records.english: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
records.chinese: 显然，它分不清印度音乐和爵士乐的区别！

records.english: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole, the American explorer, R.E.
records.chinese: 1929年，也就是他飞越北极三年后，美国探险家R.E.……

records.english: Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time.
records.chinese: 伯德首次成功飞越了南极。

records.english: Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below, they soon ran into serious trouble.
records.chinese: 虽然起初伯德和队员们拍到了许多下方群山的照片，但他们很快遇上了严重的麻烦。

records.english: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
records.chinese: 有那么一刻，飞机似乎肯定会坠毁。

records.english: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
records.chinese: 飞机只有升到一万英尺才能越过群山。

records.english: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
records.chinese: 伯德立即命令队员们扔掉两袋沉重的食品。

records.english: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
records.chinese: 飞机这才得以上升，以高出山顶四百英尺的高度越过群山。

records.english: Byrd knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole, which was 300 miles away, for there were no more mountains in sight.
records.chinese: 伯德知道自己将能到达三百英里外的南极，因为视野里再没有山了。

records.english: The plane was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
records.chinese: 飞机得以毫无困难地飞越一望无际的白色平原。

records.english: Mrs.
records.chinese: 夫人（姓名前的称谓）

records.english: Anne Sterling did not think of the risk she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men.
records.chinese: 安妮·斯特林穿过森林追赶两名男子时，没有考虑到自己正在冒的风险。

records.english: They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest with her children and tried to steal her handbag.
records.chinese: 她正和孩子们在森林边野餐时，那两人冲到她跟前，企图偷走她的手提包。

records.english: In the struggle, the strap broke and, with the bag in their possession, both men started running through the trees.
records.chinese: 争夺中，包带断了；两人拿到包，便开始穿过树林逃跑。

records.english: Mrs Sterling was so angry that she ran after them.
records.chinese: 斯特林夫人气得追了上去。

records.english: She was soon out of breath, but she continued to run.
records.chinese: 她很快就气喘吁吁，但仍继续跑。

records.english: When she caught up with them, she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag, so she ran straight at them.
records.chinese: 她追上他们时，看见他们已坐下来，正在翻看包里的东西，于是径直向他们冲去。

records.english: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.
records.chinese: 两人吓了一大跳，扔下包就逃走了。

records.english: ‘The strap needs mending,’ said Mrs Sterling later, ‘but they did not steal anything.’
records.chinese: “包带需要修补，”斯特林夫人后来说，“不过他们什么也没偷走。”

records.english: Six months ago, my husband bought an old car.
records.chinese: 六个月前，我丈夫买了一辆旧车。

records.english: He bought it from a man who lived in a small village.
records.chinese: 他是从一个住在小村庄的男子那里买的这辆车。

records.english: Last week, the car broke down on the way home.
records.chinese: 上周，汽车在回家的路上抛锚了。

records.english: My husband drove it to a garage.
records.chinese: 我丈夫把车开到了一家汽车修理厂。

records.english: The mechanic examined it and told him that a lot of parts were worn out.
records.chinese: 修理工检查了汽车，告诉他很多零件都磨损严重。

records.english: My husband decided to buy a new car, so he put the old car up for sale.
records.chinese: 我丈夫决定买辆新车，于是把旧车拿出来出售。

records.english: He received an offer from a man who lived in another village.
records.chinese: 他收到了一位住在另一个村庄的男子提出的购买报价。

records.english: The man came to see the car and agreed to buy it.
records.chinese: 那名男子来看车，并同意买下它。

records.english: He paid the full price and drove it away.
records.chinese: 他付了全款，把车开走了。

records.english: My husband was very pleased.
records.chinese: 我丈夫非常满意。

records.english: But later, he found a bag with £500 in it under the back seat.
records.chinese: 但后来，他在后座下面发现了一个装有五百英镑的袋子。

records.english: He felt very guilty.
records.chinese: 他感到非常内疚。

records.english: He tried to find the buyer, but the man had moved.
records.chinese: 他试图找到买家，可那人已经搬走了。

records.english: My husband wrote a letter to the local newspaper.
records.chinese: 我丈夫给当地报社写了一封信。

records.english: The next day, the man appeared and returned the money.
records.chinese: 第二天，那名男子出现了，并归还了钱。

records.english: He said he had no idea how the money had got there.
records.chinese: 他说自己完全不知道那笔钱是怎么到那里的。

records.english: My husband was very relieved.
records.chinese: 我丈夫大大松了一口气。

records.english: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport,
records.chinese: 当一架从伦敦飞来的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，

records.english: workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
records.chinese: 工人们开始卸下一些装有衣物的木箱。

records.english: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
records.chinese: 没有人能解释其中一个箱子格外重这一事实。

records.english: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
records.chinese: 有个工人突然想到可以打开箱子。

records.english: He was astonished at what he found.
records.chinese: 他对自己发现的情况感到十分惊讶。

records.english: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
records.chinese: 一个男人正躺在箱子里，箱子压在一堆羊毛制品上面。

records.english: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
records.chinese: 他吃惊到被人发现了都没试图逃跑。

records.english: After he was arrested,
records.chinese: 在他被逮捕之后，

records.english: the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
records.chinese: 该男子承认在飞机离开伦敦之前藏在箱子里。

records.english: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip,
records.chinese: 他经历了一段漫长又难受的旅程，

records.english: for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
records.chinese: 因为他被困在木箱里超过十八个小时。（注：本句是原因分句片段，补充说明前句旅途漫长难受的原因）

records.english: The man was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip.
records.chinese: 该男子被责令支付3500英镑的行程费用。

records.english: The normal price of a ticket is £2,000!
records.chinese: 一张票的正常价格是两千英镑！

records.english: A public house which was recently bought by Mr.
records.chinese: 一所最近被某先生买下的小酒馆（本片段为人名不完整的片段，Mr. 后姓氏未给出）

records.english: Ian Thompson is up for sale.
records.chinese: 伊恩·汤普森（的酒馆）正待售。

records.english: Mr.
records.chinese: 先生

records.english: Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
records.chinese: 汤普森打算把它卖掉，因为这地方闹鬼。

records.english: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
records.chinese: 他告诉我，有天晚上他睡不着，因为他听到酒吧里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

records.english: The next morning, he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
records.chinese: 第二天早上，他发现门被椅子堵住了，家具也被挪动过。

records.english: Though Mr.
records.chinese: 虽然先生（…，片段，语义不完整）

records.english: Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed, they were on in the morning.
records.chinese: 汤普森上床睡觉前已经把灯关了，可早上灯却是亮着的。

records.english: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
records.chinese: 他还说，他发现了五只空威士忌酒瓶，肯定是鬼在前一天晚上喝光的。

records.english: When I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink, Mr.
records.chinese: 当我提出有些村民想必是进来喝杯免费饮料时，先生（此处为Mr.的未完成称呼片段）

records.english: Thompson shook his head.
records.chinese: 汤普森先生摇了摇头。

records.english: The villagers have told him that they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
records.chinese: 村民们已经告诉他，即使他把酒馆白送出去，他们也不会接手这家酒馆。

records.english: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
records.chinese: 牙医总在你没法回答的时候问问题。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
records.chinese: 我的牙医刚拔掉了我的一颗牙，还让我休息一会儿。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
records.chinese: 我试着想说点什么，可嘴里塞满了药棉。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
records.chinese: 他知道我收集火柴盒，于是问我的收藏是不是越来越多了。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
records.chinese: 然后他问我哥哥身体怎么样，以及我是否喜欢在伦敦的新工作。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
records.chinese: 作为对这些问题的回答，我要么点点头，要么发出奇怪的声音。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
records.chinese: 与此同时，我的舌头正忙着找出那颗牙齿原来所在的洞。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
records.chinese: 我突然感到很担心，但什么也不能说。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
records.chinese: 当牙医终于把我嘴里的药棉取出来时，我才得以告诉他，他拔错了牙。
records.lesson: Lesson 48 Did you want to tell me something?

records.english: Tired of sleeping on the floor, a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed.
records.chinese: 由于厌倦了睡地板，德黑兰的一名年轻人攒了多年钱，想买一张真正的床。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: For the first time in his life,
records.chinese: 在他的人生中第一次，
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: he became the proud owner of a bed which had springs and a mattress.
records.chinese: 他成了一张配有弹簧和床垫的床的得意主人。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: Because the weather was very hot, he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
records.chinese: 因为天气非常热，他把床搬到了自己房子的屋顶上。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: He slept very well for the first two nights, but on the third night, a storm blew up.
records.chinese: 他头两个晚上睡得很好，但到了第三个晚上，一场暴风雨袭来。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
records.chinese: 一阵风把床从屋顶刮了下去，床径直坠落到了下面的院子里。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: The young man did not wake up until the bed had struck the ground.
records.chinese: 这个年轻人直到床撞到地面才醒过来。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: Although the bed was smashed to pieces, the man was miraculously unhurt.
records.chinese: 尽管床摔成了碎片，这个人却奇迹般地没有受伤。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: When he woke up, he was still on the mattress.
records.chinese: 当他醒来时，他仍然在床垫上。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: Glancing at the bits of wood and metal around him, he sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
records.chinese: 他瞥了一眼周围的木块和金属碎片，难过地拿起床垫，把它搬进了自己的房子。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: After that, he never slept on the roof again.
records.chinese: 在那之后，他再也没有睡在屋顶上了。
records.lesson: Lesson 49 The end of a dream

records.english: I love travelling in the country, but I don't like losing my way.
records.chinese: 我喜欢在乡间旅行，但我不喜欢迷路。

records.english: I went on an excursion recently,
records.chinese: 我最近去远足，

records.english: but my trip took me longer than I expected.
records.chinese: 但我的旅行比我预期的要长。

records.english: ‘I'm going to Woodford Green,
records.chinese: “我要去伍德福德格林，

records.english: ’ I said to the conductor as I got on the bus,
records.chinese: 我上车时对售票员说，

records.english: ‘but I don't know where it is.’
records.chinese: “可我不知道它在哪儿。”

records.english: ‘I'll tell you where to get off,’ answered the conductor.
records.chinese: “我会告诉你在哪下车，” 售票员回答说。

records.english: I sat at the front of the bus to enjoy the view.
records.chinese: 我坐在公共汽车的前部，以便欣赏风景。

records.english: After some time, the bus stopped.
records.chinese: 过了一段时间，公共汽车停了下来。

records.english: I looked round and realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
records.chinese: 我环顾四周，震惊地意识到自己是公交车上唯一剩下的乘客。

records.english: ‘You'll have to get off here,’ the conductor said.
records.chinese: “你得在这儿下车，”售票员说道。

records.english: ‘This is as far as we go.’
records.chinese: “我们就到这儿了。”

records.english: ‘Is this Woodford Green?’ I asked.
records.chinese: “这是伍德福德格林吗？”我问道。

records.english: ‘Oh dear,’ said the conductor suddenly, ‘I forgot to put you off.’
records.chinese: “哎呀，”售票员突然说，“我忘了叫你下车了。”

records.english: ‘It doesn't matter,’ I said.
records.chinese: “没关系，”我说。

records.english: ‘I'll get off here.’
records.chinese: “我要在这里下车。”

records.english: ‘We're going back now,’ said the conductor.
records.chinese: “我们现在要返程了，”售票员说道。

records.english: ‘Well, in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus,’ I answered.
records.chinese: “嗯，既然那样的话，我更愿意留在车上。”我回答道。

records.english: I stayed on the bus and it went back to the town centre.
records.chinese: 我留在了公交车上，随后车开回了镇中心。

records.english: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat, but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
records.chinese: 我的朋友休一直都很胖，但最近情况变得实在太糟，以至于他决定开始节食。

records.english: He began his diet a week ago.
records.chinese: 他一周前开始节食了。

records.english: First of all,
records.chinese: 首先，

records.english: he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
records.chinese: 他列了一份长长的、所有被禁止食物的清单。

records.english: The list included most of the things Hugh loves: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
records.chinese: 这份清单包含了休喜爱的大部分东西：黄油、土豆、大米、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和糖果。

records.english: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
records.chinese: 昨天我去看望了他。

records.english: I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
records.chinese: 我按了铃，看到休仍然像往常一样胖，并不觉得惊讶。

records.english: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
records.chinese: 他把我领进他的房间，然后急忙把一个大包裹藏在他的书桌底下。

records.english: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
records.chinese: 显然他当时非常尴尬。

records.english: When I asked him what he was doing, he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
records.chinese: 当我问他在做什么的时候，他内疚地笑了笑，然后把包裹放到了桌子上。

records.english: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
records.chinese: 里面装有五大块巧克力和三袋糖果！

records.english: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
records.chinese: 他解释说，他的饮食控制得非常严格，以至于不得不偶尔奖励一下自己。

records.english: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
records.chinese: 我们刚搬进了一所新房子，而我整个上午都在卖力干活。

records.english: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
records.chinese: 我一直想把我的新房间整理整齐。

records.english: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
records.chinese: 这件事一直不容易，因为我有一千多本书。

records.english: To make matters worse, the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
records.chinese: 更糟糕的是，房间相当小，所以我暂时把我的书放在了地板上。

records.english: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
records.chinese: 此刻，它们铺满了每一寸地面，我实际上不得不踩着它们走才能进出房间。

records.english: A short while ago,
records.chinese: 不久前，

records.english: my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
records.chinese: 我妹妹帮我把我的一个旧书架搬上了楼梯。

records.english: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
records.chinese: 她走进我的房间，看到地板上全是那些书时，大吃了一惊。

records.english: ‘This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,’ she said.
records.chinese: “这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯。”她说道。

records.english: She gazed at it for some time then added, ‘You don't need bookcases at all.
records.chinese: 她盯着它看了一会儿，然后接着说：“你根本不需要书架。”

records.english: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!’
records.chinese: “你可以在空闲时坐在这里，对着地毯‘阅读’啊！”

records.english: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
records.chinese: 消防员终于扑灭了加州的一场森林大火。

records.english: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
records.chinese: 从那时起，他们一直试图查明火灾是如何发生的。

records.english: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
records.chinese: 森林火灾常常由碎玻璃或者人们随手丢弃的烟头引起。

records.english: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but were not able to find any broken glass.
records.chinese: 昨天，消防员仔细检查了地面，却没能找到任何碎玻璃。

records.english: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
records.chinese: 他们也相当肯定，一个烟头并不是引起这场火灾的原因。

records.english: This morning, however, a fireman accidentally discovered the cause.
records.chinese: 不过，今天早上一名消防员意外发现了起火原因。

records.english: He noticed the remains of a snake which had been wrapped round the wires of a 16,000-volt power line.
records.chinese: 他注意到一条蛇的残骸，这条蛇曾缠绕在一根16000伏输电线路的电线上。

records.english: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
records.chinese: 就这样，他得以解开这个谜团。

records.english: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
records.chinese: 这解释很简单，却非常不寻常。

records.english: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
records.chinese: 一只鸟从地上叼起了蛇，然后把它扔到了电线上。

records.english: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
records.chinese: 那条蛇随后缠住了电线。

records.english: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
records.chinese: 当它这样做时，它把火花溅落到地面上，这些火花随即引发了一场火灾。

records.english: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
records.chinese: 早餐后，我把孩子们送到学校，然后我去了商店。

records.english: It was still early when I returned home.
records.chinese: 我回到家的时候，天还早。

records.english: I put the groceries in the kitchen and began to make some biscuits.
records.chinese: 我把食品杂货放进厨房，然后开始做一些饼干。

records.english: I mixed butter and sugar first, then added flour and milk and finally an egg.
records.chinese: 我先把黄油和糖混合，接着加入面粉和牛奶，最后加了一个鸡蛋。

records.english: I was busy mixing butter and sugar when the telephone rang.
records.chinese: 我正忙着搅拌黄油和糖，这时电话铃响了。

records.english: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Mrs Bates.
records.chinese: 我用两根粘糊糊的手指拿起听筒，一认出是贝茨夫人的声音就感到沮丧。

records.english: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later.
records.chinese: 我花了十分钟说服她晚点再回电。

records.english: At last I hung up the receiver.
records.chinese: 我终于挂断了听筒。

records.english: What a mess!
records.chinese: 真是一团糟！

records.english: There was dough all over my hands and the telephone.
records.chinese: 我的手上和电话机上到处都是面团。

records.english: Just then, the doorbell rang.
records.chinese: 就在这时，门铃响了。

records.english: It was the postman.
records.chinese: 是邮递员。

records.english: I didn't want to open the door with sticky fingers, so I kicked the door with my foot, but it stuck.
records.chinese: 我不想用粘糊糊的手开门，就用脚踢门，可门卡住了。

records.english: I had to push very hard to get it open.
records.chinese: 我只得费很大的劲推，才把门打开。

records.english: The postman was holding a large parcel.
records.chinese: 邮差当时正拿着一个大包裹。

records.english: ‘I have a registered letter for you,’ he said.
records.chinese: “我有一封给你的挂号信，”他说道。

records.english: I took it and signed for it.
records.chinese: 我接过它，然后签了收。

records.english: As soon as I could, I washed my hands.
records.chinese: 我一得空就洗了手。

records.english: Then I finished making the biscuits.
records.chinese: 然后我做完了饼干。

records.english: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
records.chinese: 寻找失落宝藏的梦想最近差一点就实现了。

records.english: A new machine called ‘The Revealer’ has been invented and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
records.chinese: 一种名叫‘探宝器’的新机器已经被发明出来，并已用于探测埋在地下的黄金。

records.english: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where it is said pirates used to hide gold.
records.chinese: 这台机器被用于海边附近的一个洞穴，据说海盗过去常在那里藏金子。

records.english: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
records.chinese: 海盗往往把金子埋在洞里，后来却没能把它取回。

records.english: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
records.chinese: 一支搜索队带着这台新机器走进洞穴，希望找到埋藏的宝物。

records.english: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
records.chinese: 领队正在洞口附近检查土壤，这时机器显示地下有黄金。

records.english: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
records.chinese: 队员们十分兴奋，挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

records.english: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
records.chinese: 他们终于找到一枚小金币，但它几乎一文不值。

records.english: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
records.chinese: 随后，搜索队彻底搜遍了整个洞穴，却只找到一个空铁皮箱。

records.english: In spite of this,
records.chinese: 尽管如此，

records.english: many people are confident that ‘The Revealer’ may reveal something of value fairly soon.
records.chinese: 许多人相信，‘探宝器’很快可能会发现有价值的东西。

records.english: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
records.chinese: 每年举行一次老式汽车比赛。

records.english: A lot of old cars entered for this race last year and there were a great many visitors.
records.chinese: 去年有许多老式汽车报名参加这场比赛，观众也很多。

records.english: The race was held on a straight course.
records.chinese: 比赛在一条笔直的赛道上举行。

records.english: The cars began their race at 8 a.m.
records.chinese: 汽车于上午八点开始比赛。

records.english: Some of the cars went very fast, but others moved very slowly.
records.chinese: 有些汽车开得很快，另一些却行驶得很慢。

records.english: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
records.chinese: 最漂亮的汽车之一是一辆劳斯莱斯‘银魅’。

records.english: The most unusual car was a 1904 Mercedes which had only three wheels.
records.chinese: 最不寻常的是一辆1904年的奔驰车，它只有三个轮子。

records.english: It finished the race in 9 hours and 15 minutes.
records.chinese: 这辆车用了九小时十五分钟跑完比赛。

records.english: The winner was a 1928 Austin Seven.
records.chinese: 获胜的是一辆1928年的奥斯汀‘七型’汽车。

records.english: Its speed was just over 30 miles per hour.
records.chinese: 它的时速刚刚超过三十英里。

records.english: It reached a speed of 76 miles an hour on the straight parts of the course.
records.chinese: 它在赛道的直线路段达到了每小时七十六英里的速度。

records.english: After the race, the driver said, ‘The old car can go faster than that.’
records.chinese: 赛后，司机说：‘这辆老车还能开得比那更快。’

records.english: Everyone agreed that it was a very exciting race.
records.chinese: 大家一致认为这是一场十分激动人心的比赛。

records.english: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
records.chinese: 一位穿牛仔裤的女士站在一家高档商店的橱窗前，请求看看橱窗里的一条连衣裙。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.
records.chinese: 接待她的店员不喜欢她的打扮。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
records.chinese: 他轻蔑地瞥了她一眼，告诉她那条裙子已经卖出去了。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
records.chinese: 女士气愤地走出商店，决定第二天教训这个店员。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: She returned the following morning dressed in a fur coat, with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
records.chinese: 第二天早晨她回来了，穿着皮草大衣，一手拿手提包，另一手拿长柄伞。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: After seeking out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
records.chinese: 找到那个粗鲁的店员后，她要求看同一条裙子。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
records.chinese: 店员没有认出她，这次却急切地想为她服务。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
records.chinese: 他费了很大劲才爬进橱窗去取那条裙子。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: As soon as she saw it, the woman said, ‘I don't want this dress.
records.chinese: 她一看到裙子就说：‘我不要这条裙子。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: I want a dress from the window.’
records.chinese: 我要一条橱窗里的裙子。’
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: She pointed to another dress.
records.chinese: 她指向另一条裙子。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: The assistant had to get that one too.
records.chinese: 店员只好把那条也取来。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: He was exhausted when the woman paid for the two dresses and walked out of the shop with the assistant carrying them.
records.chinese: 女士付了两条裙子的钱并走出商店时，店员已经精疲力尽，还替她提着裙子。
records.lesson: Lesson 57 Can I help you, madam?

records.english: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a ‘cursed’ tree.
records.chinese: 据说弗林利这个小村庄有一棵‘受诅咒的’树。

records.english: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago,
records.chinese: 这棵树是五十年前种在教堂附近的，

records.english: but it has only recently gained an evil reputation.
records.chinese: 但它直到最近才有了恶名。

records.english: It is believed that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die.
records.chinese: 人们相信，谁碰这棵树就会倒霉，谁摘一片叶子就会死。

records.english: Many villagers have tried to cut the tree down,
records.chinese: 许多村民都曾试图砍倒这棵树，

records.english: but so far they have not succeeded.
records.chinese: 但到目前为止，他们还没有成功。

records.english: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down,
records.chinese: 有人请求牧师安排人把这棵树砍倒，

records.english: but so far he has refused.
records.chinese: 但到目前为止，他都拒绝了。

records.english: He says that the tree is a useful source of income,
records.chinese: 他说这棵树是一个很有用的收入来源，

records.english: as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
records.chinese: 因为全国各地的游客一直来这里看它。

records.english: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists keep coming.
records.chinese: 尽管有这些说法，游客还是不断前来。

records.english: So far, no one has been struck down by sudden death,
records.chinese: 到目前为止，还没有人突然死亡，

records.english: but I am sure that there is something unusual about this tree.
records.chinese: 但我确信，这棵树有某种不寻常之处。

records.english: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
records.chinese: 我们的狗雷克斯以前常坐在前门外吠叫。

records.english: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
records.chinese: 每次它想进花园，就会一直叫，直到有人把门打开。

records.english: As the neighbours complained of the noise,
records.chinese: 由于邻居们抱怨噪音，

records.english: my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
records.chinese: 我丈夫花了几个星期训练它把爪子按在门闩上，好让它自己进来。

records.english: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
records.chinese: 雷克斯很快就成了开门的能手。

records.english: Then my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed he has not been able to open it since.
records.chinese: 后来我丈夫把门移走了，雷克斯十分恼火，从那以后一直没能再把它打开。

records.english: Now, when he wants to go out, he sits by the fence and barks.
records.chinese: 现在，它想出去时，就坐在栅栏旁叫。

records.english: When he comes back, he sits outside and barks until someone lets him in.
records.chinese: 它回来时，就坐在外面叫，直到有人让它进来。

records.english: He has developed a bad habit.
records.chinese: 它养成了一个坏习惯。

records.english: Every evening, he barks and barks until midnight.
records.chinese: 每天晚上，它叫个不停，一直叫到半夜。

records.english: We have tried everything, but nothing works.
records.chinese: 我们什么办法都试过了，可是什么都不管用。

records.english: We have even tried to lock him in the house, but he still barks.
records.chinese: 我们甚至试过把它关在屋里，可它仍然叫。

records.english: What can we do?
records.chinese: 我们还能怎么办呢？

records.english: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
records.chinese: 在一次乡村集市上，我决定去找一位名叫贝林斯基夫人的算命者。

records.english: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
records.chinese: 我走进她的帐篷，她叫我坐下。

records.english: After I had given her some money,
records.chinese: 我给了她一些钱之后，
