records.english: she looked into a crystal ball and said: ‘A relation of yours is coming to see you.
records.chinese: 她凝视水晶球，说：“你的一个亲戚要来看你。

records.english: She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
records.chinese: 她今晚会到，打算住上几天。

records.english: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
records.chinese: 你一离开这个帐篷，就会大吃一惊。

records.english: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
records.chinese: 一个你很熟悉的女人会朝你奔来。

records.english: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place.
records.chinese: 她会和你说话，然后带你离开这里。

records.english: That is all.’
records.chinese: 就这些了。”

records.english: I walked out of the tent and forgot all about Madam Bellinsky.
records.chinese: 我走出帐篷，把贝林斯基夫人的事全忘了。

records.english: My sister was waiting for me when I got home.
records.chinese: 我到家时，姐姐正在等我。

records.english: ‘We've been looking for you,’ she said.
records.chinese: “我们一直在找你，”她说。

records.english: ‘Aunt Mary is arriving this evening and we are going to meet her at the station.
records.chinese: “玛丽阿姨今晚到，我们打算去车站接她。

records.english: Come with us.’
records.chinese: 跟我们一起去吧。”

records.english: I followed her out of the house.
records.chinese: 我跟着她走出屋子。

records.english: We had hardly gone a hundred yards when a car stopped beside us.
records.chinese: 我们才走了不到一百码，一辆车就停在我们旁边。

records.english: It was Aunt Mary!
records.chinese: 竟然是玛丽阿姨！

records.english: She got out of the car and said, ‘I'm sorry I'm late.
records.chinese: 她下了车，说：“抱歉，我来晚了。

records.english: I tried to get here earlier, but I couldn't get away.
records.chinese: 我想尽早赶到，可是脱不开身。

records.english: I've got a surprise for you.
records.chinese: 我有个惊喜要告诉你。

records.english: I'm going to stay with you for a few days.’
records.chinese: 我打算在你这里住几天。”

records.english: I remembered Madam Bellinsky's words.
records.chinese: 我想起了贝林斯基夫人的话。

records.english: It was a very strange coincidence.
records.chinese: 这真是个十分奇怪的巧合。

records.english: The Hubble telescope was launched into space by NASA on April 24, 1990, at a cost of over a billion dollars.
records.chinese: 哈勃望远镜于1990年4月24日由美国国家航空航天局发射升空，耗资超过十亿美元。

records.english: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
records.chinese: 哈勃望远镜从一开始就出了问题。

records.english: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty.
records.chinese: 它传给我们的照片令人非常失望，因为它的主镜有缺陷。

records.english: NASA is now going to put the telescope right, so it will send up four astronauts to repair it.
records.chinese: 美国国家航空航天局现在打算修好望远镜，因此将派四名宇航员升空维修。

records.english: The shuttle Endeavour will take the astronauts to the Hubble.
records.chinese: 奋进号航天飞机将把宇航员送到哈勃望远镜那里。

records.english: A robotic arm will be used to hold the telescope while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
records.chinese: 宇航员进行必要维修时，将用一只机械臂固定望远镜。

records.english: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere,
records.chinese: 当然，哈勃望远镜位于地球大气层之外，

records.english: so it will be able to send us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
records.chinese: 因此它将能给我们传来我们迄今见过的最清晰的恒星和遥远星系照片。

records.english: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
records.chinese: 消防员连续扑救森林大火近三周，才得以控制火势。

records.english: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
records.chinese: 不久之前，方圆数英里的乡野还覆盖着参天大树。

records.english: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
records.chinese: 此时，荒凉山丘上仍有烟从尚有余温的地面升起。

records.english: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction, for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
records.chinese: 冬季渐近，山丘给周围村庄带来了毁灭的危险，因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会造成严重洪水。

records.english: When the fire had at last been put out,
records.chinese: 大火终于被扑灭后，

records.english: the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
records.chinese: 林业部门订购了几吨一种能迅速生长的特殊草籽。

records.english: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
records.chinese: 飞机将大量草籽播撒在地面上。

records.english: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
records.chinese: 开始下雨时，飞机已经持续播种近一个月了。

records.english: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
records.chinese: 然而，到那时，许多地方的草已经生根了。

records.english: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries,
records.chinese: 原先在那里生长了几个世纪的大树被取代了，

records.english: patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
records.chinese: 焦黑的土壤中已经开始出现一片片绿色。

records.english: My friend, Jeremy, has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
records.chinese: 我的朋友杰里米交友很广，在聚会上很受欢迎。

records.english: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour — everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
records.chinese: 人人都欣赏他出众的幽默感——准确地说，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮。

records.english: Recently, Jeremy was
records.chinese: 最近，杰里米……

records.english: In 1858, a French engineer, Aimé Thomé de Gamond, arrived in England with a plan for a twenty-one-mile tunnel under the English Channel.
records.chinese: 1858年，法国工程师艾梅·托梅·德·加蒙带着在英吉利海峡下修建一条二十一英里长隧道的方案来到英国。

records.english: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
records.chinese: 他说，可以在海峡中央建一个平台。

records.english: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.
records.chinese: 这个平台将用作港口和火车站。

records.english: The tunnel would be well-ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level.
records.chinese: 如果在海平面以上建造高大的烟囱，隧道就会通风良好。

records.english: In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman, William Low.
records.chinese: 1860年，一位名叫威廉·洛的英国人提出了一个更好的方案。

records.english: He suggested that a double railway tunnel should be built.
records.chinese: 他建议修建一条双轨铁路隧道。

records.english: This would solve the problem of ventilation,
records.chinese: 这将解决通风问题，

records.english: for if a train entered this tunnel,
records.chinese: 因为如果一列火车驶入这条隧道，

records.english: it would draw in fresh air behind it.
records.chinese: 它就会把新鲜空气带进身后的隧道。

records.english: Forty-two years later a tunnel was actually begun.
records.chinese: 四十二年后，一条隧道真的开始修建了。

records.english: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
records.chinese: 如果当时英国人没有担心遭到入侵，隧道本来就会建成。

records.english: The world had to wait almost another 100 years for the Channel Tunnel.
records.chinese: 世界还不得不再等将近一百年，才迎来海峡隧道。

records.english: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.
records.chinese: 它于1994年3月7日正式开放，终于将英国与欧洲大陆连接起来。

records.english: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital.
records.chinese: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定给一家儿童医院送些礼物。

records.english: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a 'guard of honour' of six pretty girls, he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
records.chinese: 他扮成圣诞老人，由六位漂亮姑娘组成的“仪仗队”陪同，骑着名叫江伯的小象，沿着城市主街出发了。

records.english: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
records.chinese: 他本该知道，警察绝不会允许这种事。

records.english: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
records.chinese: 一名警察走近吉米，告诉他本该走一条小街，因为江伯正堵着交通。

records.english: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
records.chinese: 虽然吉米同意马上离开，江伯却不肯动。

records.english: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
records.chinese: 十五名警察不得不用力推，才把它弄离主街。

records.english: The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused.
records.chinese: 警察费了很大劲，却觉得十分好笑。

records.english: 'Jumbo must weigh a few tons,
records.chinese: “江伯一定有好几吨重，

records.english: ' said a policeman afterwards,
records.chinese: ”一名警察事后说，

records.english: 'so it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him.
records.chinese: “所以幸好我们不用抬它。

records.english: Of course, we should arrest him,
records.chinese: 当然，我们应该逮捕它，

records.english: but as he has a good record,
records.chinese: 但由于它一向表现良好，

records.english: we shall let him off this time.'
records.chinese: 这次我们就饶过它吧。”

records.english: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island,
records.chinese: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机在瓦利斯岛坠毁，

records.english: a remote place in the South Pacific,
records.chinese: 那是南太平洋的一个偏远地方，

records.english: a long way west of Samoa.
records.chinese: 在萨摩亚以西很远的地方。

records.english: The plane wasn't too badly damaged, but over the years, the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
records.chinese: 飞机损坏并不太严重，但年复一年，坠机事件被遗忘，残骸也一直无人碰动。

records.english: Then in 1989,
records.chinese: 后来到了1989年，

records.english: twenty-six years after the crash,
records.chinese: 也就是坠机二十六年后，

records.english: the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
records.chinese: 飞机在对岛屿的一次航空勘察中被意外重新发现。

records.english: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
records.chinese: 到那时，保存状况尚好的兰开斯特轰炸机已很罕见，值得抢救。

records.english: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
records.chinese: 法国当局安排把飞机拆成部分，包装后运回法国。

records.english: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
records.chinese: 现在，一群爱好者打算安排修复这架飞机。

records.english: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines,
records.chinese: 它有四台劳斯莱斯梅林发动机，

records.english: but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
records.chinese: 但这群人只需要安排修复其中三台。

records.english: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey — still in perfect condition.
records.chinese: 想想他们撬开包装箱，发现第四台发动机甜如蜂蜜、仍然完好无损时，是多么惊讶和高兴。

records.english: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and during its long flight home, honey had been dripping from it.
records.chinese: 一群蜜蜂早把发动机变成了蜂巢，在它漫长的返乡飞行中，蜂蜜一直从里面滴下来。

records.english: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
records.chinese: 波兰科学家哈罗恩·塔捷耶夫毕生研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。

records.english: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
records.chinese: 1948年，他前往刚果的基伍湖观察一座新火山，后来把它命名为基图罗。

records.english: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
records.chinese: 火山猛烈喷发时，塔捷耶夫仍能在离它很近的地方搭起营地。

records.english: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs,
records.chinese: 虽然他成功拍到了一些出色的照片，

records.english: he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
records.chinese: 他却无法在火山附近久留。

records.english: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
records.chinese: 他注意到一股河流般的熔岩正朝他涌来。

records.english: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
records.chinese: 熔岩眼看就要把他完全包围，但塔捷耶夫设法及时逃脱了。

records.english: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.
records.chinese: 他一直等到火山平静下来，两天后才得以返回。

records.english: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
records.chinese: 这次，他成功爬进基图罗火山口，以便拍照和测量温度。

records.english: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
records.chinese: 塔捷耶夫经常这样冒生命危险。

records.english: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
records.chinese: 关于活火山，他能告诉我们的知识比任何在世的人都多。

records.english: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him, but he saw me and came running towards me.
records.chinese: 我穿过街道想避开他，但他看见了我，朝我跑过来。

records.english: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him, so I waved to him.
records.chinese: 装作没看见他已经没用了，所以我朝他挥了挥手。

records.english: I never enjoy meeting Bert Dykes.
records.chinese: 我从来不喜欢碰见伯特·戴克斯。

records.english: He never has anything to do.
records.chinese: 他总是无事可做。

records.english: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
records.chinese: 不管你多忙，他总坚持要跟你一起去。

records.english: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
records.chinese: 我不得不想个办法，防止他整个上午都跟着我转。

records.english: 'Hello, Bert,' I said.
records.chinese: “你好，伯特，”我说。

records.english: 'Fancy meeting you here!'
records.chinese: “真巧，竟在这儿碰见你！”

records.english: 'Hi, Elizabeth,' Bert answered.
records.chinese: “嗨，伊丽莎白，”伯特回答。

records.english: 'I was just wondering how to spend the morning — until I saw you.
records.chinese: “见到你之前，我刚才还在琢磨怎么打发这个上午。

records.english: You're not busy doing anything, are you?'
records.chinese: 你没在忙什么吧？”

records.english: 'No, not at all,' I answered.
records.chinese: “没有，一点也不忙，”我回答。

records.english: 'I'm going to...'
records.chinese: “我打算……”

records.english: 'Would you mind my coming with you?' he asked, before I had finished speaking.
records.chinese: “你介意我跟你一起去吗？”我还没说完，他就问道。

records.english: 'Not at all,' I lied, 'but I'm visiting the dentist.'
records.chinese: “一点也不介意，”我撒谎说，“不过我要去看牙医。”

records.english: 'Then I'll come with you,' he answered.
records.chinese: “那我就跟你一起去，”他回答。

records.english: 'There's always plenty to read in the waiting room!'
records.chinese: “候诊室里总有很多东西可读！”

records.english: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
records.chinese: 我当时正在第三次参加驾驶执照考试。

records.english: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully.
records.chinese: 我先前被要求在车流密集的路段驾驶，而且已经顺利做到了。

records.english: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
records.chinese: 接到开车出城的指示后，我开始有了信心。

records.english: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
records.chinese: 确信自己已经通过了，我几乎开始享受这场考试了。

records.english: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said, 'Just one more thing, Mr.
records.chinese: 考官当时一定对我的表现很满意，因为他微笑着说：“只剩一件事了，先生……

records.english: Eames.
records.chinese: 伊姆斯。

records.english: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.
records.chinese: 我们假设有个孩子突然在你面前横穿马路。

records.english: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.'
records.chinese: “我一敲车窗，你就必须在五英尺内停下。”
records.parentEnglish: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.' I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.

records.english: I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.
records.chinese: 我继续开车，过了一会儿，考官重重地敲了车窗。
records.parentEnglish: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.' I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.

records.english: Though the sound could be heard clearly,
records.chinese: 虽然那声音听得很清楚，

records.english: it took me a long time to react.
records.chinese: 我过了很久才作出反应。

records.english: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard and we were both thrown forward.
records.chinese: 我突然猛踩刹车踏板，我们两人都被甩向前方。

records.english: The examiner looked at me sadly.
records.chinese: 考官难过地看着我。

records.english: 'Mr.
records.chinese: “先生……

records.english: Eames,' he said, in a mournful voice, 'you have just killed that child!'
records.chinese: “伊姆斯，”他用悲伤的语调说，“你刚刚把那个孩子撞死了！”

records.english: During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.
records.chinese: 斗牛进行时，一个醉汉突然晃进了场地中央。

records.english: The crowd began to shout, but the drunk was unaware of the danger.
records.chinese: 人群开始大喊，醉汉却没有意识到危险。

records.english: The bull was busy with the matador at the time, but it suddenly caught sight of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap.
records.chinese: 当时公牛正忙着对付斗牛士，却突然看见那个醉汉正大声叫骂、挥舞着红帽子。

records.english: Apparently sensitive to criticism, the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
records.chinese: 公牛似乎对批评很敏感，把斗牛士忘得一干二净，向醉汉猛冲过去。

records.english: The crowd suddenly grew quiet.
records.chinese: 人群突然安静了下来。

records.english: The drunk, however, seemed quite sure of himself.
records.chinese: 然而，那个醉汉似乎对自己相当有信心。

records.english: When the bull got close to him, he clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.
records.chinese: 公牛靠近他时，他笨拙地向旁边跨了一步，让它过去。

records.english: The crowd broke into cheers and the drunk bowed.
records.chinese: 观众爆发出欢呼声，醉汉鞠了一躬。

records.english: By this time, however, three men had come into the ring and they quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
records.chinese: 然而，到这时已有三个人进入场内，他们很快把醉汉拖到了安全的地方。

records.english: Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him, for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
records.chinese: 连公牛似乎都为他感到难过，因为它同情地旁观着，等醉汉离开不再挡道后，才再次把注意力转向斗牛士。

records.english: When you visit London,
records.chinese: 你到伦敦游览时，

records.english: one of the first things you will see is Big Ben,
records.chinese: 你最先会看到的事物之一就是大本钟，

records.english: the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C.
records.chinese: 那座著名的大钟，世界各地都能通过英国广播公司的广播听到它的钟声。

records.english: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834,
records.chinese: 如果议会大厦没有在1834年被烧毁，

records.english: the great clock would never have been erected.
records.chinese: 这座大钟就根本不会建起来。

records.english: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.
records.chinese: 大本钟得名于本杰明·霍尔爵士；新议会大厦建造期间，他负责大钟的制作。

records.english: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.
records.chinese: 它不仅体积巨大，而且走时极其准确。

records.english: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
records.chinese: 格林威治天文台的官员每天安排对大钟检查两次。

records.english: On the B.B.C. you can hear the clock when it is actually striking because microphones are connected to the clock tower.
records.chinese: 通过英国广播公司的广播，你能在大钟实际敲响报时时听到钟声，因为麦克风连接在钟塔上。

records.english: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong.
records.chinese: 大本钟很少出过故障。

records.english: Once, however, it failed to give the correct time.
records.chinese: 不过，有一次它没能报出正确的时间。

records.english: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
records.chinese: 一个先前一直在塔上干活的油漆工，把一桶油漆挂在一根指针上，结果让大钟走慢了！

records.english: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
records.chinese: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士，是首位以超过每小时300英里的速度驾驶汽车的人。

records.english: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
records.chinese: 1935年9月，他在犹他州邦纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。

records.english: Bluebird, his famous racing car, was powered by a 2,000 horse-power engine.
records.chinese: 他那辆著名的“蓝鸟”赛车，由一台2000马力的发动机提供动力。

records.english: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
records.chinese: 虽然坎贝尔的时速达到了304英里以上，但他很难控制赛车，因为首次试跑中有个轮胎爆了。

records.english: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
records.chinese: 试跑结束后，坎贝尔得知自己的平均时速是299英里，感到很失望。

records.english: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
records.chinese: 然而，几天后有人告诉他，先前弄错了。

records.english: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
records.chinese: 他当时的平均时速其实是301英里。

records.english: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
records.chinese: 自那以后，赛车手们已达到过每小时600英里以上的速度。

records.english: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
records.chinese: 多年以后，马尔科姆爵士的儿子唐纳德追随父亲的足迹，也创造了一项世界纪录。

records.english: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
records.chinese: 和父亲一样，他驾驶的也是一辆名叫“蓝鸟”的汽车。

records.english: # Unit 4 Lesson73–96
records.chinese: 第四单元，第73至96课。

records.english: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
records.chinese: 逃学的孩子们缺乏想象力。

records.english: A quiet day's fishing,
records.chinese: 安安静静地钓一天鱼，

records.english: or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again,
records.chinese: 或者在电影院里花八小时，一遍又一遍地看同一部电影，

records.english: is usually as far as they get.
records.chinese: 通常也就是他们能做到的程度了。

records.english: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, travelled 1,600 miles.
records.chinese: 一个逃学期间走了1600英里的男孩，让他们全都相形见绌。

records.english: He hitchhiked to Dover and towards evening went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
records.chinese: 他搭便车到了多佛，傍晚时上了一条船，想找个地方睡觉。

records.english: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
records.chinese: 第二天早晨醒来时，他发现船在此期间已经驶到了加莱。

records.english: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
records.chinese: 他悄悄溜走时，没有人注意到这个男孩。

records.english: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
records.chinese: 他从那里搭上一辆卡车，去了巴黎。

records.english: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
records.chinese: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，然后把他留在紧挨城外的地方。

records.english: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would,
records.chinese: 男孩拦下的下一辆车，并没有像他希望的那样把他送到巴黎市中心，

records.english: but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
records.chinese: 而是到了法国与西班牙边境上的佩皮尼昂。

records.english: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
records.chinese: 在那里，一名警察把他带走，当地当局随后把他送回了英国。

records.english: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of boys who dream of evading school.
records.chinese: 对成千上万梦想逃学的男孩来说，他无疑创造了一项纪录。

records.english: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
records.chinese: 一辆老掉牙的公共汽车停在干涸的河床旁，一群著名的男女演员下了车。

records.english: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
records.chinese: 他们戴着墨镜、穿着旧衣服，特意采取了防范措施，以免有人认出他们。

records.english: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
records.chinese: 但正如他们很快发现的那样，伪装有时会过于完美。

records.english: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
records.chinese: “这里真是野餐的好地方，”格洛丽亚·格利姆说。

records.english: 'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.
records.chinese: “再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯赞同道。

records.english: 'No newspaper men, no film fans!
records.chinese: “没有新闻记者，没有影迷！

records.english: Why don't we come more often?'
records.chinese: 我们为什么不常来呢？”

records.english: Meanwhile, two other actors, Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves, had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
records.chinese: 与此同时，另外两位演员罗克沃尔·斯林格和默林·格里夫斯已经把两个大食品篮搬到树下的一处阴凉地方。

records.english: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
records.chinese: 当他们都安顿得舒舒服服时，一个陌生人出现了。

records.english: He looked very angry.
records.chinese: 他看上去很生气。

records.english: 'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.
records.chinese: “现在你们都给我离开这里！”他喊道。

records.english: 'I'm sheriff of this district.
records.chinese: “我是这个辖区的治安官。

records.english: I've had a lot of complaints about campers camping here.'
records.chinese: 我已接到不少对在这里露营的人的投诉。”

records.english: 'Why don't you explain who we are?'
records.chinese: “你为什么不解释一下我们是谁呢？”

records.english: said Brinksley.
records.chinese: 布林克斯利说。

records.english: 'I don't care who you are,' the sheriff retorted.
records.chinese: “我不管你们是谁，”治安官反驳道。

records.english: 'There are signs everywhere saying "No camping"!'
records.chinese: “到处都有写着‘禁止露营’的告示牌！”

records.english: When Rockwall told him that they were famous actors, the sheriff laughed loudly.
records.chinese: 当罗克沃尔告诉他他们是著名演员时，治安官大笑起来。

records.english: 'The only actors I see around here are in the local amateur theatre,
records.chinese: “我在这一带见到的演员，都在本地业余剧团里，

records.english: ' he said.
records.chinese: ”他说。

records.english: 'If you ask me, you look like a gang of tramps.
records.chinese: “依我看，你们看起来像一伙流浪汉。

records.english: Clear off before I call the police!'
records.chinese: 趁我还没叫警察，你们赶快走开！”

records.english: When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago, it crashed in the mountains and its pilot was killed.
records.chinese: 前些时候，一架轻型客机偏离了航线，坠毁在山区，飞行员遇难。

records.english: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
records.chinese: 机上仅有的乘客——一位年轻妇女和她两个年幼的女儿——都没有受伤。

records.english: It was the middle of winter.
records.chinese: 当时正值隆冬。

records.english: Snow lay thick on the ground.
records.chinese: 地上积着厚厚的雪。

records.english: The woman knew that the nearest village was miles away.
records.chinese: 这位妇女知道，最近的村庄也在几英里之外。

records.english: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it, covering them with all the clothes she could find.
records.chinese: 天黑时，她把一个手提箱当作床，把孩子放进去，用能找到的所有衣服盖住她们。

records.english: During the night, it got terribly cold.
records.chinese: 夜里，天气变得极其寒冷。

records.english: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
records.chinese: 这位妇女尽可能紧挨着孩子，甚至想自己也钻进箱子，但箱子太小了。

records.english: Early next morning,
records.chinese: 第二天一早，

records.english: she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
records.chinese: 她听到飞机从头顶飞过，便琢磨怎样发出求救信号。

records.english: Then she had an idea.
records.chinese: 这时她想出了一个办法。

records.english: She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow.
records.chinese: 她在雪地里踩出了“SOS”这几个字母。

records.english: Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
records.chinese: 幸运的是，一名飞行员看见了信号，用无线电向最近的城镇发送了消息。

records.english: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
records.chinese: 没过多久，一架直升机便赶到现场，营救这次空难的幸存者。

records.english: To end our special news bulletin, the voice of the television announcer was heard.
records.chinese: 为结束我们的特别新闻简报，电视播音员的声音响了起来。

records.english: 'As we all know, Macclesfield has long been famous for its cheese.
records.chinese: “众所周知，麦克尔斯菲尔德长期以来以奶酪闻名。

records.english: Today we bring you a special report from our correspondent, Alan Jones, who is in the village of Barnley, where the latest cheese-making experiment is taking place.
records.chinese: 今天由我们的通讯员艾伦·琼斯为大家带来一则特别报道，他正在巴恩利村，那里正在进行最新的奶酪制作实验。

records.english: 'For months, farmers in Barnley have been feeding their cows a special mixture of herbs and grass.
records.chinese: “几个月来，巴恩利的农民一直给奶牛喂一种特制的草药与青草混合饲料。

records.english: The result is a new type of cheese which has an unusual flavour.
records.chinese: 结果是一种风味不同寻常的新型奶酪。

records.english: But the real surprise is that the cheese does not need to be stored for months to ripen.
records.chinese: 但真正令人惊讶的是，这种奶酪无需存放数月来成熟。

records.english: It is ready to eat within twenty-four hours.
records.chinese: 它在二十四小时内就可以食用了。

records.english: 'Our reporter, Alan Jones, has been watching the cheese being made.
records.chinese: “我们的记者艾伦·琼斯一直在观看奶酪的制作过程。

records.english: Over to you, Alan.'
records.chinese: 艾伦，现在交给你。”

records.english: 'Thank you, Tom,' said Alan.
records.chinese: “谢谢你，汤姆，”艾伦说。

records.english: 'The cheese is produced in huge round blocks, each weighing nearly 50 kilos.
records.chinese: “奶酪被制成巨大的圆块，每块重近五十公斤。

records.english: Farmers here are confident that this new cheese will sell all over the country.
records.chinese: 当地农民确信，这种新奶酪将在全国销售。

records.english: They are planning to increase production next year.
records.chinese: 他们正在计划明年增加产量。

records.english: And now, back to Tom in the studio.'
records.chinese: 现在回到演播室里的汤姆那里。”

records.english: 'Thank you, Alan,' said the announcer with a smile.
records.chinese: “谢谢你，艾伦，”播音员微笑着说。

records.english: 'And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April 1st.
records.chinese: “今天——四月一日，星期四——的特别简报到此结束。

records.english: We are now returning you to the regular programmes.'
records.chinese: 现在为大家恢复播放常规节目。”

records.english: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
records.chinese: 一具属于公元前八百年去世的埃及妇女的木乃伊，刚刚接受了一次手术。

records.english: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
records.chinese: 这具木乃伊属于谢彭穆特，她曾是底比斯神庙的一名歌手。

records.english: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy,
records.chinese: 由于给木乃伊拍摄的X光片上有奇怪的痕迹，

records.english: doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
records.chinese: 医生们一直在设法查明这位妇女是否死于一种罕见疾病。

records.english: The only way to do this was to operate.
records.chinese: 要查明这一点，唯一的办法就是动手术。

records.english: The operation, which lasted for over four hours, proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
records.chinese: 手术持续了四个多小时，由于皮肤上覆盖着坚硬的树脂，事实证明这次手术非常困难。

records.english: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
records.chinese: 医生们从木乃伊身上取下一部分，把它送到实验室。

records.english: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
records.chinese: 他们还发现了X光片没有显示的东西：一尊杜阿穆特夫神的小蜡像。

records.english: This god which has the head of a jackal was used to guard the dead.
records.chinese: 这个长着豺头的神被用来守护死者。

records.english: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
records.chinese: 医生们尚未判定这位妇女是怎样死亡的。

records.english: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open,
records.chinese: 他们曾担心，切开木乃伊时它会散成碎片，

records.english: but fortunately this has not happened.
records.chinese: 但幸运的是，这种情况并没有发生。

records.english: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
records.chinese: 这具木乃伊成功地挺过了手术。

records.english: After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health' I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
records.chinese: 读完一篇题为《吸烟与你的健康》的文章后，我点了一支烟来镇定神经。

records.english: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
records.chinese: 我专心而愉快地抽着，因为我确信这将是我最后一支烟。

records.english: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time,
records.chinese: 整整一周我一支烟也没抽，而在这段时间里，

records.english: my wife suffered terribly.
records.chinese: 我妻子受了很大的罪。

records.english: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
records.chinese: 我具备戒烟者通常会有的所有症状：脾气暴躁，食欲极大。

records.english: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
records.chinese: 朋友们不断给我递香烟和雪茄。

records.english: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
records.chinese: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果，他们都毫不掩饰自己的好笑。

records.english: After seven days of this I went to a party.
records.chinese: 这样过了七天后，我去参加了一次聚会。

records.english: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
records.chinese: 我周围人人都在抽烟，我感到极不舒服。

records.english: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette,
records.chinese: 当我的老朋友布赖恩劝我接一支烟时，

records.english: it was more than I could bear.
records.chinese: 这实在超过了我所能忍受的限度。

records.english: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
records.chinese: 我内疚地接过一支，点燃它，满足地抽了起来。

records.english: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.
records.chinese: 妻子很高兴，事情又恢复了正常。

records.english: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
records.chinese: 不管怎样，正如布赖恩指出的，戒烟是世界上最容易的事。

records.english: He himself has done it lots of times!
records.chinese: 他自己就已经戒过好多次了！

records.english: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
records.chinese: 我小时候经常乘飞机旅行。

records.english: My parents used to live in South America and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays.
records.chinese: 父母过去住在南美洲，我过去常在假期从欧洲飞到那里。

records.english: A flight attendant would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.
records.chinese: 一位空乘人员会照顾我，我从来没有过不愉快的经历。

records.english: I am used to travelling by air and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
records.chinese: 我习惯乘飞机旅行，只有一次曾感到害怕。

records.english: After taking off,
records.chinese: 起飞后，

records.english: we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height,
records.chinese: 我们正低空飞越城市，缓缓爬升，

records.english: when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
records.chinese: 就在这时，飞机突然掉头飞回机场。

records.english: While we were waiting to land, a flight attendant told us to keep calm and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
records.chinese: 等候降落时，一位空乘人员告诉我们保持镇定，飞机一着陆就安静地离机。

records.english: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious to find out what had happened.
records.chinese: 机上每个人都很担心，我们急于弄清究竟发生了什么。

records.english: Later we learnt that there was a very important person on board.
records.chinese: 后来我们得知，机上有一位非常重要的人物。

records.english: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
records.chinese: 警方此前接到消息，说飞机上被安放了一枚炸弹。

records.english: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.
records.chinese: 我们降落后，飞机受到了彻底搜查。

records.english: Fortunately, nothing was found and five hours later we were able to take off again.
records.chinese: 幸运的是，没有发现任何东西，五小时后我们得以再次起飞。

records.english: Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century was the Crystal Palace,
records.chinese: 也许十九世纪最非凡的建筑是水晶宫，

records.english: which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
records.chinese: 它是为1851年的世界博览会在海德公园建造的。

records.english: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world,
records.chinese: 水晶宫与世界上其他所有建筑都不同，

records.english: for it was made of iron and glass.
records.chinese: 因为它是由铁和玻璃建成的。

records.english: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
records.chinese: 它是有史以来最大的建筑之一，许多国家的很多人都来参观。

records.english: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
records.chinese: 大量商品从世界各地被送到展会上。

records.english: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
records.chinese: 还有大量机器在展出。

records.english: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
records.chinese: 展出的机器中最精彩的一件是内史密斯的蒸汽锤。

records.english: Though in those days, travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
records.chinese: 虽然那时旅行不如今天方便，蒸汽船还是把成千上万的游客从欧洲运过英吉利海峡。

records.english: On arriving in England, they were taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
records.chinese: 他们一到英国，就被火车送往水晶宫。

records.english: There were six million visitors in all,
records.chinese: 参观者总共有六百万人，

records.english: and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
records.chinese: 展览的利润被用来建造博物馆和学院。

records.english: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.
records.chinese: 后来，水晶宫被迁到了伦敦南部。

records.english: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.
records.chinese: 它一直是世界上最著名的建筑之一，直到1936年被烧毁。

records.english: When he had killed the guard,
records.chinese: 他杀死哨兵后，

records.english: the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
records.chinese: 战俘迅速把他拖进灌木丛。

records.english: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
records.chinese: 他在黑暗中迅速行动，很快换上了死者的衣服。

records.english: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder, the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
records.chinese: 现在，战俘身穿蓝色制服，肩扛步枪，大胆地在营地前来回行进。

records.english: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
records.chinese: 他能听见营地里面的喊叫声。

records.english: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there: they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
records.chinese: 灯火通明，人们四处奔跑：他们刚发现有一名战俘逃跑了。

records.english: At that moment,
records.chinese: 就在那时，

records.english: a large black car with four officers inside it,
records.chinese: 一辆里面坐着四名军官的大黑车，

records.english: stopped at the camp gates.
records.chinese: 停在了营地大门口。

records.english: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
records.chinese: 军官们下了车；他们经过时，战俘立正敬礼。

records.english: When they had gone, the driver of the car came towards him.
records.chinese: 军官们走后，汽车司机朝他走来。

records.english: The man obviously wanted to talk.
records.chinese: 那人显然想聊聊。

records.english: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
records.chinese: 他年纪颇大，灰白头发，眼睛清澈湛蓝。

records.english: The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do.
records.chinese: 战俘很同情他，但也没有别的办法。

records.english: As the man came near,
records.chinese: 那人走近时，

records.english: the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow.
records.chinese: 战俘猛击一下，把他打倒在地。

records.english: Then, jumping into the car, he drove off as quickly as he could.
records.chinese: 然后，他跳进汽车，以最快的速度开走了。

records.english: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
records.chinese: 渔民和水手有时声称在海里见过怪物。

records.english: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen, it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
records.chinese: 虽然人们常嘲笑海员讲的故事，但现在已经知道，这些时有目击的“怪物”许多不过是奇异的鱼。

records.english: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
records.chinese: 奇异的生物偶尔被冲上岸，但在外海却很少被捕到。

records.english: Some time ago, however, a fishing-boat was hauling its nets near the Mediterranean when the nets suddenly dragged something heavy.
records.chinese: 然而，不久前，一条渔船正在地中海附近收网时，渔网突然拖住了一个重物。

records.english: The fisherman thought they had caught a whale,
records.chinese: 那位渔民以为他们捕到了一条鲸，

records.english: but when the strange creature was eventually brought to shore,
records.chinese: 但当这只奇异的生物终于被运到岸上时，

records.english: it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
records.chinese: 发现它有十三英尺多长。

records.english: It had a flat head,
records.chinese: 它有一个扁平的头，

records.english: big eyes, a silver skin and a long thin tail.
records.chinese: 大眼睛、银色皮肤和一条细长尾巴。

records.english: Its body was covered with hard bony plates.
records.chinese: 它的身体覆盖着坚硬的骨质板。

records.english: The fish, which has since been sent to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
records.chinese: 这条鱼后来被送到一家博物馆，正在那里接受一位科学家的检查，它叫桨鱼。

records.english: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
records.chinese: 人类很少见到这种生物活着的样子，因为它们生活在六百英尺深处。

records.english: The former Prime Minister, Mr.
records.chinese: 前首相，……先生

records.english: Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
records.chinese: 文特沃斯·莱恩，在最近的选举中落败了。

records.english: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
records.chinese: 他现在正退出政坛，而且已经出国了。

records.english: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr.
records.chinese: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是……先生的狂热反对者（所反对的对象待续）。

records.english: Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
records.chinese: 莱恩的激进进步党。

records.english: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
records.chinese: 选举结束后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。

records.english: When he asked if Mr.
records.chinese: 当他问……先生是否……时（话未完），

records.english: Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
records.chinese: 莱恩住在那里，值班警察告诉他，前首相自落败后就已经出国了。

records.english: On the following day, Patrick went to the house again.
records.chinese: 第二天，帕特里克又去了那所住宅。

records.english: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance,
records.chinese: 同一名警察当时正慢慢走过入口，

records.english: when Patrick asked the same question.
records.chinese: 这时帕特里克又问了同一个问题。

records.english: Though a little suspicious this time, the policeman gave him the same answer.
records.chinese: 虽然这次有点起疑，警察还是给了他同样的答复。

records.english: The day after, Patrick visited the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
records.chinese: 又过了一天，帕特里克再次登门，问了完全一样的问题。

records.english: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
records.chinese: 这一次，警察发火了。

records.english: 'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted, 'Mr.
records.chinese: “我昨天和前天都告诉过你了，”他喊道，“……先生（话未完）

records.english: Lane was defeated in the elections.
records.chinese: 莱恩在选举中落败了。

records.english: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'
records.chinese: 他已经退出政坛，去国外生活了！”

records.english: 'I know,' answered Patrick, 'but I love to hear you say it!'
records.chinese: “我知道，”帕特里克回答，“但我就是爱听你说这件事！”

records.english: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
records.chinese: 公共汽车职工已决定下周罢工。

records.english: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
records.chinese: 罢工预定星期二开始。

records.english: No one knows how long it will last.
records.chinese: 没人知道罢工会持续多久。

records.english: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
records.chinese: 公共汽车职工已经声明，罢工将持续到各方就工资和工作条件达成普遍共识为止。

records.english: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
records.chinese: 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一周。

records.english: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.
records.chinese: 许多私家车主打算在上班途中为人们提供免费搭车服务。

records.english: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
records.chinese: 这会在一定程度上减轻火车的客运压力。

records.english: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
records.chinese: 与此同时，一些大学生已自愿提出在罢工期间驾驶公共汽车。

records.english: All the students are expert drivers,
records.chinese: 所有这些学生都是熟练的驾驶者，

records.english: but before they drive any of the buses,
records.chinese: 但在他们驾驶这些公共汽车中的任何一辆之前，

records.english: they will have to pass a special test.
records.chinese: 他们必须先通过一项专门的考试。

records.english: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
records.chinese: 这些学生打算两天后参加考试。

records.english: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
records.chinese: 即便如此，人们仍会发现到单位上班很困难。

records.english: But so far,
records.chinese: 但截至目前，

records.english: the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in letters to the press.
records.chinese: 公众已经在写给报刊的信中向学生们表达了感谢。

records.english: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
records.chinese: 只有一两个人提出异议，说学生们会开得太快！

records.english: I have just received a letter from my old school informing me that my former headmaster, Mr.
records.chinese: 我刚收到母校的一封信，通知我，我从前的校长，……先生（消息待续）。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
records.chinese: 斯图尔特·佩奇，将于下周退休。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: Pupils of the school,
records.chinese: 这所学校的学生们，
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: old and new,
records.chinese: 包括老校友和在校学生，
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
records.chinese: 将给他送一份礼物，以纪念这个时刻。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
records.chinese: 所有为礼物出过钱的人都会在一本大纪念册上签名，这本纪念册将送到校长家中。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: We shall all remember Mr.
records.chinese: 我们都会记得……先生（姓名待续）。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
records.chinese: 佩奇，因他的耐心与体谅，也因我们很不情愿去上学时他给予的亲切鼓励。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
records.chinese: 许多老校友将在下星期四参加为向他致敬而举办的告别晚宴。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr.
records.chinese: 有趣的巧合是，在他退休的前一天，……先生（内容待续）。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
records.chinese: 佩奇届时将已累计任教四十年。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: After he has retired, he will devote himself to gardening.
records.chinese: 退休后，他将专心从事园艺。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
records.chinese: 对他来说，这将是一项全新的爱好。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
records.chinese: 但这没有关系，因为正如他常说的，人无论多大年纪都可以学习。
records.lesson: Lesson 85 Never too old to learn

records.english: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
records.chinese: 那人试图让快艇转向时，方向盘竟脱落在他手里。

records.english: He waved desperately to his companion,
records.chinese: 他拼命向同伴挥手，

records.english: who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
records.chinese: 这位同伴此前已经连续滑水十五分钟了。

records.english: The young man had not seen the danger and was still enjoying himself.
records.chinese: 年轻人还没察觉危险，仍然玩得很开心。

records.english: The speedboat had struck a buoy,
records.chinese: 快艇已经撞上了一个浮标，

records.english: but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
records.chinese: 但它仍继续在水面上飞快行驶。

records.english: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
records.chinese: 两人几乎还没来得及弄清发生了什么，就被猛地甩进海里。

records.english: The speedboat, meanwhile, had already begun to circle.
records.chinese: 与此同时，快艇已经开始打转。

records.english: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
records.chinese: 汽油已经几乎全部耗尽了。

records.english: Within minutes, the noise died down and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
records.chinese: 几分钟内，噪声减弱了，快艇开始在水面上轻轻漂流。

records.english: The men swam towards the shore, but the boat was moving away from them.
records.chinese: 两人向岸边游去，可船却正漂离他们。

records.english: Just as they were beginning to lose hope,
records.chinese: 正当他们开始失去希望时，

records.english: they saw a small fishing boat passing by.
records.chinese: 他们看见一艘小渔船正从旁经过。

records.english: They shouted and waved until the fisherman noticed them and came to their rescue.
records.chinese: 他们不停地喊叫、挥手，直到渔夫注意到他们并赶来营救。

records.english: 'At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train to London,' said the man.
records.chinese: “谋杀发生时，我正乘八点的火车去伦敦，”那人说。

records.english: 'Do you always catch such an early train?'
records.chinese: “你总是乘这么早的火车吗？”

records.english: asked the inspector.
records.chinese: 探长问道。

records.english: 'Of course I do,' answered the man.
records.chinese: “当然总是如此，”那人回答。

records.english: 'I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
records.chinese: “我十点必须在岗。

records.english: My employer will confirm that I was there on time.'
records.chinese: 我的雇主会证实我当时准时到岗了。”

records.english: 'Would a later train get you to work on time?'
records.chinese: “晚一班火车也能让你准时到岗吗？”

records.english: asked the inspector.
records.chinese: 探长问道。

records.english: 'I suppose it would, but I never catch a later train.'
records.chinese: “我想能，不过我从不乘晚一班的火车。”

records.english: 'At what time did you arrive at the station?'
records.chinese: “你几点到达车站的？”

records.english: 'At ten to eight.
records.chinese: “七点五十。

records.english: I bought a paper and waited for the train.'
records.chinese: 我买了一份报纸，等着火车。”

records.english: 'And you didn't notice anything unusual?'
records.chinese: “而且你没有注意到任何异常？”

records.english: 'Of course not.'
records.chinese: “当然没有。”

records.english: 'I suggest,' said the inspector, 'that you are not telling the truth.
records.chinese: “我认为，”探长说，“你没有说实话。

records.english: I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train, but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
records.chinese: 我认为你没有乘八点的火车，而是乘了八点二十五那班，它仍能让你准时到岗。

records.english: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train did not run at all.
records.chinese: 你看，谋杀发生那天早晨，八点的火车根本没有开。

records.english: It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.'
records.chinese: 它在芬格林车站出了故障，被撤出了运行线路。”

records.english: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
records.chinese: 六个人被困在矿井里已经十七小时了。

records.english: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.
records.chinese: 如果不尽快把他们救到地面，他们可能会丧命。

records.english: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
records.chinese: 然而，救援行动正显现出困难。

records.english: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
records.chinese: 如果使用炸药，震动会使矿井顶板坍塌。

records.english: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
records.chinese: 因此，救援人员正在矿井北侧钻一个孔。

records.english: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
records.chinese: 他们打算用一种特制救生舱把这些人运上来。

records.english: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil,
records.chinese: 要是土层下面没有一层坚硬的岩石，

records.english: they would have completed the job in a few hours.
records.chinese: 他们本来几个小时就能完成工作了。

records.english: As it is, they have been drilling for sixteen hours and they still have a long way to go.
records.chinese: 但实际情况是，他们已钻了十六个小时，而且离完成还差得远。

records.english: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago, has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
records.chinese: 与此同时，两小时前放入矿井的一只麦克风已使这些人能够与至亲保持联系。

records.english: Though they are running out of food and drink, the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
records.chinese: 虽然食物和饮水快用完了，这些人仍很乐观，相信自己很快会出去。

records.english: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
records.chinese: 他们已被告知，救援行动进展顺利。

records.english: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
records.chinese: 如果他们知道钻透坚硬岩石有多困难，就会失去信心。

records.english: People will do anything to see a free show — even if it is a bad one.
records.chinese: 人们为了看一场免费演出什么都肯做——哪怕演出很差。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: When the news got round that a variety show would be presented at our local cinema by the P. and U.
records.chinese: 当本地电影院将由P.与U.……公司举办一场综艺演出的消息传开时（公司名称待续），
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
records.chinese: ……鸟食公司时，我们全都赶去看了。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
records.chinese: 我们排了几个小时的队才进去；演出开始前，现场肯定有好几百人。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
records.chinese: 不幸的是，这场演出是我们看过的最无聊的演出之一。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
records.chinese: 没能入场的人其实不必失望，因为许多本应出场的演员没有来。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
records.chinese: 那晚我们听到的唯一好笑的东西，来自节目开始时广告员说的话。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
records.chinese: 他显然很紧张，在麦克风前局促地站了好几分钟。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
records.chinese: 他刚一开口，大家就放声大笑。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: We all know what the poor man should have said,
records.chinese: 我们都知道那个可怜的人本应该说什么，
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company.
records.chinese: 但他实际说的是：“这是Poo与Ee籽鸟公司。
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
records.chinese: 好女士们，晚上和先生们！”（原文口误）
records.lesson: Lesson 89 A slip of the tongue

records.english: Though Brazil is one of the richest countries in the world,
records.chinese: 虽然巴西是世界上最富有的国家之一，

records.english: much of it has not yet been developed.
records.chinese: 它的大部分地区却还没有得到开发。

records.english: It was mainly for this reason that the Brazilian government decided to have a new city built 600 miles north-west of Rio de Janeiro.
records.chinese: 主要就是出于这个原因，巴西政府决定在里约热内卢西北600英里处建一座新城。

records.english: Designed by the great architect Lucio Costa, the new city, Brasilia, replaced Rio de Janeiro as the capital of Brazil in 1960.
records.chinese: 由伟大建筑师卢西奥·科斯塔设计的新城巴西利亚于1960年取代里约热内卢，成为巴西首都。

records.english: Brasilia has been carefully planned for modern living.
records.chinese: 巴西利亚是为现代生活而精心规划的。

records.english: Its wide roads, which can take fourteen lanes of traffic, have been kept away from living areas.
records.chinese: 其宽阔道路可容纳十四条车道的车辆通行，而且与居住区保持距离。

records.english: Children do not have to cross busy streets to go to school.
records.chinese: 孩子们上学不必穿过繁忙的街道。

records.english: Housewives can visit shopping centres on foot for in these specially designed living areas,
records.chinese: 家庭主妇可以步行去购物中心，因为在这些专门设计的居住区内，

records.english: cars are unnecessary.
records.chinese: 汽车是没有必要的。

records.english: At the time, many people thought that Brasilia would never succeed.
records.chinese: 当时，许多人认为巴西利亚永远不会成功。

records.english: Today, however, it is the capital of the country and its population has grown rapidly.
records.chinese: 然而今天，它已是这个国家的首都，人口也迅速增长了。

records.english: Meanwhile, off the coast of Brazil, fishing boats used to catch large fish.
records.chinese: 与此同时，在巴西沿海，渔船过去常能捕到大鱼。

records.english: Now they catch tiny fish only, because the big ones have all been taken.
records.chinese: 现在他们只能捕到小鱼，因为大鱼都已经被捕走了。

records.english: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force Station nearby.
records.chinese: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，似乎正飞向附近的皇家空军基地。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
records.chinese: 他立即通知了基地，但那里没有人能解释这个谜。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: The officer on the ground was very angry when he heard this.
records.chinese: 地面上的军官听到这个消息后非常生气。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: Balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
records.chinese: 气球可能给飞机带来极大的危险。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
records.chinese: 他说可能有人正在刺探基地，并命令飞行员追踪这个奇怪的物体。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
records.chinese: 飞行员设法绕着气球盘旋了一段时间。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
records.chinese: 他能辨认出气球下面的篮子里有三个人，其中一人正拿着一副望远镜。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: When the balloon was over the airfield,
records.chinese: 当气球飞到机场上空时，
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
records.chinese: 飞行员看见其中一人正在拍照。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
records.chinese: 不久后，气球开始下降，降落在一座机场附近。
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: The police were called in,
records.chinese: 警方被召来介入，
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: but they could not arrest anyone,
records.chinese: 但他们无法逮捕任何人，
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
records.chinese: 因为篮子里竟是两名议会议员和基地指挥官！
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: As the Commanding Officer explained later,
records.chinese: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
records.chinese: 基地的一半人竟不知道另一半人在做什么！
records.lesson: Lesson 91 Three men in a basket

records.english: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
records.chinese: 我回到家时，想必已经是凌晨两点左右了。

records.english: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell,
records.chinese: 我试着按门铃叫醒妻子，

records.english: but she was fast asleep,
records.chinese: 但她睡得很熟，

records.english: so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden,
records.chinese: 于是我从花园里的工具棚取了一把梯子，

records.english: put it against the wall,
records.chinese: 把它靠在墙上，

records.english: and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
records.chinese: 然后开始朝卧室窗户爬去。

records.english: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said,
records.chinese: 我差不多快爬到了，这时下面传来一个讥讽的声音说，

records.english: 'I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.'
records.chinese: “我看，窗户不需要在夜里这个时候擦吧。”

records.english: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
records.chinese: 我往下一看，看见警察时差点从梯子上摔下来。

records.english: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did,
records.chinese: 我立刻后悔刚才那样回答，

records.english: but I said,
records.chinese: 但我还是说，

records.english: 'I enjoy cleaning windows at night.'
records.chinese: “我喜欢在夜里擦窗户。”

records.english: 'So do I,' answered the policeman in the same tone.
records.chinese: “我也是。”警察用同样的语气回答。

records.english: 'Excuse my interrupting you.
records.chinese: “请原谅我打扰您。

records.english: I hate to interrupt a man when he's busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?'
records.chinese: 我不愿打扰一个正在忙的人，不过您介意跟我去一趟警局吗？”

records.english: 'Well, I'd prefer to stay here,' I said.
records.chinese: “嗯，我宁愿待在这里。”我说。

records.english: 'You see, I've forgotten my key.'
records.chinese: “您知道，我忘带钥匙了。”

records.english: 'Your what?'
records.chinese: “你的什么？”

records.english: he called.
records.chinese: 他喊道。

records.english: 'My key,' I shouted.
records.chinese: “我的钥匙！”我大声喊道。

records.english: Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.
records.chinese: 幸好喊声吵醒了妻子，她打开窗户时，警察刚开始向我爬来。

records.english: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty, was presented to the United States of America in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
records.chinese: 世界上最著名的纪念物之一——自由女神像，是法国人民于十九世纪赠送给美利坚合众国的。

records.english: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
records.chinese: 这座宏伟雕像由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，历时十年才完成。

records.english: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
records.chinese: 雕像主体用铜制成，由金属框架支撑，框架是埃菲尔专门建造的。

records.english: Before it could be transported to the United States, a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
records.chinese: 在它能够运往美国之前，必须先为它找到一处地点，并建好一座基座。

records.english: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
records.chinese: 选定的地点是纽约港入口处的一座岛。

records.english: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
records.chinese: 到1884年，一座高151英尺的雕像已经在巴黎竖立起来。

records.english: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
records.chinese: 第二年，它被拆成部件，运往美国。

records.english: By the end of October 1886, the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
records.chinese: 到1886年10月底，雕像已重新组装好，并由巴托尔迪正式赠送给美国人民。

records.english: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
records.chinese: 从那以后，对数百万经过纽约港到美国定居的人来说，这座伟大纪念物一直是自由的象征。

records.english: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
records.chinese: 实验证明，儿童很小的时候就可以接受游泳训练。

records.english: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles,
records.chinese: 在洛杉矶的一座专用游泳池里，

records.english: children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
records.chinese: 孩子们甚至在会走路之前，就已经很擅长在水下屏气。

records.english: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
records.chinese: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抗拒下水。

records.english: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
records.chinese: 用不了多久，他们就熟悉游泳到能从池底捡起重物的程度。

records.english: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
records.chinese: 一种很受这些小游泳者欢迎的游戏是水下三轮车比赛。

records.english: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
records.chinese: 三轮车在水下七英尺深的池底排成一列。

records.english: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
records.chinese: 孩子们互相竞争，看谁先到达池子的另一端。

records.english: Many pedal their tricycles, but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
records.chinese: 不少孩子踩着三轮车前进，但大多数更愿意推着或拖着车走。

records.english: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
records.chinese: 有些孩子能游完泳池全长，甚至一次也不浮上来换气。

records.english: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
records.chinese: 他们将来是否真能成为奥运冠军，只有时间才能证明。

records.english: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
records.chinese: 与此同时，他们应该能鼓舞我们这些还游不到五码就气喘吁吁的人。

records.english: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
records.chinese: 埃斯卡洛皮亚大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子大吃一惊。

records.english: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
records.chinese: 他脸色苍白，衣服也糟糕得吓人。

records.english: 'What has happened?' she asked.
records.chinese: “出什么事了？”她问。

records.english: 'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'
records.chinese: “你的衣服怎么弄得这么乱？”

records.english: 'A fire extinguisher, my dear,' answered the Ambassador drily.
records.chinese: “灭火器，亲爱的。”大使冷冷地回答。

records.english: 'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'
records.chinese: “今天上午大学生们放火烧了大使馆。”

records.english: 'Good heavens!'
records.chinese: “天哪！”

records.english: exclaimed his wife.
records.chinese: 他的妻子惊叫道。

records.english: 'And where were you at the time?'
records.chinese: “那你当时在哪里？”

records.english: 'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.
records.chinese: “我像往常一样在办公室。”大使回答。

records.english: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
records.chinese: “火是从地下室烧起来的。

records.english: I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
records.chinese: 我当然立刻下楼去了，那个傻瓜霍斯特竟把灭火器对准了我。

records.english: He thought I was on fire.
records.chinese: 他以为我身上着火了。

records.english: I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
records.chinese: 我一定得把那个家伙调走。”

records.english: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions,
records.chinese: 大使的妻子继续问着问题，

records.english: when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
records.chinese: 这时她突然注意到丈夫帽子上有个大洞。

records.english: 'And how can you explain that?' she asked.
records.chinese: “那这个你又怎么解释？”她问。

records.english: 'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.
records.chinese: “哦，那个呀。”大使说。

records.english: 'Someone fired a shot through my office window.
records.chinese: “有人朝我的办公室开了一枪，子弹穿过了窗户。

records.english: Accurate, don't you think?
records.chinese: 打得真准，你不觉得吗？

records.english: Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.
records.chinese: 幸运的是，我当时没有戴着它。

records.english: If I had been,
records.chinese: 如果我当时戴着它，

records.english: I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'
records.chinese: 我就不可能回家吃午饭了。”

records.english: A Festival for the Dead is held once a year in Japan.
records.chinese: 日本每年举行一次亡灵节。

records.english: This festival is a cheerful occasion,
records.chinese: 这个节日是一个欢乐的日子，

records.english: for on this day,
records.chinese: 因为在这一天，

records.english: the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living.
records.chinese: 据说亡者会回到家中，并受到生者的欢迎。

records.english: As they are expected to be hungry after their long journey,
records.chinese: 因为人们认为他们经过长途旅行后会饿，

records.english: food is laid out for them.
records.chinese: 人们就为他们摆好了食物。

records.english: Specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way.
records.chinese: 每家门外都挂上特制灯笼，帮助亡者找到归家的路。

records.english: All night long, people dance and sing.
records.chinese: 人们整夜载歌载舞。

records.english: In the early morning, the food that had been laid out for the dead is thrown into a river or into the sea as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it.
records.chinese: 清晨，为亡者摆出的食物被扔进河里或海里，因为人们认为活着的人吃它是不吉利的。

records.english: In towns that are near the sea,
records.chinese: 在靠海的城镇里，

records.english: the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before,
records.chinese: 前一晚挂在街上的那些小灯笼，

records.english: are placed into the water when the festival is over.
records.chinese: 在节日结束时被放进水里。

records.english: Thousands of lanterns slowly drift out to sea guiding the dead on their return journey to the other world.
records.chinese: 成千上万盏灯笼慢慢漂向大海，为亡者返回另一个世界的旅途引路。

records.english: This is a moving spectacle, for crowds of people stand on the shore watching the lanterns drifting away until they can be seen no more.
records.chinese: 这是动人的景象：成群的人站在岸边，望着灯笼渐渐漂远，直到再也看不见。
